jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.excerpt: We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production.
jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!

jobs.description:
Tabby creates financial freedom in the way people shop, earn and save by reshaping their relationship with money. Over 25 million users choose Tabby to stay in control of their spending and make the most out of their money.

The company’s flagship offering allows shoppers to split their payments online and in-store with no interest or fees. Over 70,000 global brands and small businesses, including Amazon, Noon, IKEA, and SHEIN use Tabby to accelerate growth and gain loyal customers by offering easy and flexible payments online and in stores.

Tabby generates over $18 billion in annual transaction volume for its partner brands and is the highest-rated, most-reviewed, largest, and fastest-growing FinTech in the GCC region.

Tabby launched in 2019 and has since raised +$1 billion in equity and debt funding from global and regional investors, and is now valued at $6,5 billion.

ServiceDesk is the L1 layer between frontline support and engineering. Frontline agents escalate complex customer cases to us; we resolve them or route them to the right engineering team, and we own the whole path a ticket takes: from intake and classification to SLA, escalation and closure. We build our own tools for it: an in-house analytics platform, automations in CRM and Jira, and AI-assisted handling of tickets. You will help us make that path faster, clearer and easier to measure.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own and improve the ticket flow between CRM and Jira: statuses, routing, escalation rules between L1, L2 and engineering teams;
  • Keep ticket classification and SLA targets accurate (issue types, categories, responsible teams) and fix gaps in the data;
  • Find where tickets get stuck, bounce back or breach SLA, and turn findings into process changes or clear tasks for engineering;
  • Work with frontline and engineering teams on intake quality: what a good escalation looks like and how to give feedback;
  • Automate routine steps in CRM procedures and Jira (automation rules, scripts);
  • Contribute to our internal tools and services (TypeScript / Node.js, Go): features, fixes and integrations, through merge requests and code review;
  • Help roll out and check AI-assisted ticket handling: what it gets right, where it fails, what to change;
  • Measure the effect of every change with data, and report it in a clear, short form;
  • Prepare and maintain documentation and playbooks for L1 and L2.

What you’ll bring:

  • 2+ years in technical support, support operations or a similar role with tiered support (L1/L2/L3) and SLAs;
  • Solid experience with Jira: workflows, JQL, automation rules, dashboards;
  • Experience with a CRM or helpdesk system (ticket lifecycle, queues, routing);
  • SQL for your own analysis: joins, aggregations, working with large tables;
  • Working with logs and monitoring tools to investigate issues (Datadog, Grafana, Kibana);
  • Hands-on coding in at least one of: TypeScript / JavaScript, Go, Python (Google Apps Script counts for automation);
  • Working with Git, merge requests and code review;
  • Understanding of HTTP, REST APIs and webhooks;
  • Process thinking: you can map a flow, spot the weak step and change it without breaking the rest;
  • Clear writing in English (B2): instructions, task descriptions, short reports;
  • Ownership and autonomy: you drive a change to the end, including agreeing it with other teams.
Nice to have:
  • Production experience with Node.js / TypeScript or Go services, and Postgres;
  • Jira administration, Jira Service Management or Assets;
  • Understanding of ITIL processes;
  • Google Cloud and BigQuery;
  • Experience with LLM tools or agents in support: prompts, evaluation, guardrails;
  • Experience at a fintech company and/or a startup.

What we offer:

  • Full-time B2B contract
  • Fully remote setup
  • Up to 20% tax allowance
  • 22 paid leave days annually
  • Stock options (ESOP) in a fast-scaling, pre-IPO company

Solutions Engineer, Pre-Sales

Customer Solutions Group | North America

GrowthLoop is on a mission to help marketing teams activate their data with speed and precision. As a Solutions Engineer, you'll play a critical role in driving GrowthLoop’s expansion by partnering closely with the sales team to bring our Compound Marketing Engine to life for prospective clients. You’ll bridge the gap between product and customer, helping marketers and technical stakeholders - including data engineers, analytics teams, and IT - realize the power of activating data from the data cloud to drive real business outcomes. Your ability to navigate both business and technical conversations will be key to unlocking value for complex, data-savvy organizations.

You’re comfortable speaking with confidence in a sales environment, leading demos, and answering product and technology-related questions. You have a strong understanding of Customer Data, Marketing Technology, Data Warehouses like BigQuery and Snowflake, Marketing KPIs, and Marketing Channels.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with Account Executives from discovery through close to qualify technical fit, shape account strategy, and guide customer evaluations.
  • Lead discovery with marketing and data teams to understand how they store customer data, build audiences, run campaigns, and measure results.
  • Create tailored demos, prototypes, and proofs of value with clear success criteria that show how GrowthLoop fits into each prospect’s data and marketing stack.
  • Serve as the primary technical contact during evaluations, explaining architecture, integrations, and tradeoffs to both data teams and marketing leaders.
  • Work with Account Executives on pricing and scope when technical requirements affect the proposed solution.
  • Document requirements and open questions, troubleshoot issues, and coordinate with Product and Engineering to keep evaluations moving.
  • Answer competitive questions using your knowledge of CDPs, data warehouses, identity resolution, AI in marketing, and cross-channel activation.
  • Bring recurring customer pain points and product feedback to the teams that can act on them.
  • Travel for customer meetings when being there will meaningfully help an opportunity.

What We Look For

  • 3+ years in sales engineering or technical presales, supporting complex B2B SaaS sales cycles from discovery through technical evaluation.
  • Experience supporting evaluations for enterprise data or marketing platforms, including how audiences are built from warehouse data and activated through downstream integrations.
  • Working knowledge of Snowflake or BigQuery, how customer data flows through a modern data stack, and where LLMs can add value in marketing workflows.
  • An understanding of how marketing teams choose audiences, messages, offers, and channels, and how they measure whether a campaign worked.
  • Familiarity with experimentation and incremental lift, including why a high response rate does not necessarily mean a campaign changed customer behavior.
  • Experience explaining technical concepts to both data teams and marketing leaders, adapting your approach to what each audience needs to decide.
  • Strong judgment in complex sales cycles. You can prioritize technical questions, communicate what still needs validation, and work across teams to keep an evaluation moving.

About GrowthLoop

GrowthLoop built the first composable CDP, helping marketers leverage live, first-party data from their cloud warehouse to launch highly targeted campaigns. That composable foundation gave way to the Compound Marketing Engine, an evolution of the composable CDP that drives compound growth by using agentic AI to accelerate the marketing cycle.

Now, we’re building what comes next: an agentic system that uses causality data to find the actions that actually improve customer outcomes and gets smarter with every campaign cycle.

Founder-led, we’re partnering with the world’s most innovative brands to close the loop between people, data, and AI. Enterprise marketing teams at Google, Costco, Ford, and Whirlpool (to name a few) choose GrowthLoop to launch smarter, more personalized marketing programs that compound growth with every campaign.

The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating challenging software-engineering tasks across front-end and back-end systems and helping with translating full coding builds from one particular language into another.

Contributions should demonstrate real engineering ability, not only documentation updates, dependency bumps, formatting changes, or minor typo corrections.

Candidates should be prepared to discuss specific repositories, pull requests, issues, and code they personally authored.

What You’ll Work On

  1. Explore and understand unfamiliar software repositories.
  2. Implement, modify, and debug front-end and back-end components.
  3. Trace data and execution across interfaces, services, libraries, APIs, databases, and external dependencies.
  4. Reproduce software issues and identify their underlying causes.
  5. Implement solutions that fit an existing project’s architecture and contribution standards.
  6. Write unit, integration, regression, and end-to-end tests.
  7. Review AI-generated patches for correctness, completeness, security, and maintainability.

Required Qualifications

  1. A public or otherwise verifiable GitHub profile.
  2. Meaningful ownership of or contributions to one or more open-source repositories.
  3. Strong software-engineering experience across front-end, back-end, full-stack, systems, developer tooling, infrastructure, or another substantial technical area.
  4. Experience with multiple programming languages.
  5. Ability to understand and modify unfamiliar codebases.

Relevant languages may include TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Java, Go, Rust, C++, C#, Ruby, PHP, or other languages used in substantial open-source projects.

Process

  1. Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.
  2. Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.

Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum number of tasks per week.

Start Timeline & Availability

We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first tasks within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

jobs.title: Senior Android Developer - Kotlin Multiplatform & AI Coding
jobs.excerpt: Location: 100% Remote Employment: Full-time, long-term position Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility About UsWe are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies.
jobs.description:
Location: 100% Remote
Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve our engineering workflows, and build practical knowledge across the team.

We are looking for a senior developer who can take ownership of mobile development, deliver reliable software, and help our team become more effective at building applications with AI.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Mobile App Developer with strong Kotlin Multiplatform expertise and an excellent background in native Android development with Kotlin.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will develop and improve our application, solve complex technical problems, and establish effective workflows for AI-assisted and agentic development. Experience with GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or related location and proximity technologies would be particularly valuable.

You will also share your knowledge with our internal team, including mentoring a junior team member who is learning to build Android applications through AI-assisted development, often referred to as “vibe coding.”

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and improve our Android application using Kotlin and Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Design shared application logic and integrate it with platform-specific functionality.
  • Implement and troubleshoot location and proximity features involving GPS, BLE, UWB, and related device capabilities.
  • Address practical mobile challenges such as permissions, background execution, battery consumption, connectivity, and differences between devices.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents extensively to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and support testing.
  • Set up and improve agentic development workflows, including task decomposition, project context, automated checks, and review processes.
  • Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
  • Test relevant functionality on real devices and resolve problems that automated tests alone may not reveal.
  • Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and understandable explanations.
  • Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production Android applications with Kotlin.
  • Strong practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform, including shared code, platform-specific integrations, and the boundaries between them.
  • Solid understanding of Android architecture, Jetpack Compose, coroutines, Flow, application lifecycle, and state management.
  • Strong debugging skills and the ability to investigate problems across application code, APIs, and device behavior.
  • Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
  • A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
  • The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain why an implementation is appropriate.
  • Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly.
  • The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • GPS positioning, location accuracy, sensor data, and proximity detection.
  • BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and signal-strength limitations.
  • UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility.
  • NFC and other device-to-device interactions.
  • Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • Ownership of meaningful mobile development work.
  • The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents.
  • Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your role in developing Android applications and Kotlin Multiplatform solutions.
  • Any practical experience with GPS, BLE, UWB, or similar technologies.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with an example of how they helped you deliver a working application or feature.
  • Your experience mentoring junior developers or colleagues learning AI-assisted development.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio or GitHub links are welcome where available.

jobs.title: Clinical Workflow Solution Designer
jobs.excerpt: Consensus Cloud Solutions is a publicly traded, leading digital cloud fax and interoperability solutions organization in the United States and globally, focusing on connecting and empowering healthcare providers, payers, care teams, and technology innovators to unify multiple systems that wouldn’t otherwise talk to each other.
jobs.description:
Consensus Cloud Solutions is a publicly traded, leading digital cloud fax and interoperability solutions organization in the United States and globally, focusing on connecting and empowering healthcare providers, payers, care teams, and technology innovators to unify multiple systems that wouldn’t otherwise talk to each other. Consensus is a trailblazer in our industry and believes that data transformation will reshape the world of healthcare.

Founded over 25 years ago, Consensus leverages its technology heritage to move from simple digital documents to advanced healthcare standards (HL7/FHIR) for secure data transport, as well as Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to convert unstructured to structured, analytics-ready data, helping users unveil information that is meaningful and actionable for better patient care.

Consensus leads the industry in data exchange solutions and we’re only getting started! With exciting new initiatives on the horizon, we are continuing our strategic expansion and we are looking to add to our diverse team of innovators.

Now is the ideal time to join us in our mission to solve healthcare’s biggest challenges, and work collaboratively with a diverse team of like-minded self-starters and partners to accomplish it.

Consensus Cloud Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and equitable environment for all employees. We offer many remote and hybrid career opportunities.

How you will impact the organization…

As the Clinical Workflow Solutions Engineer, you will translate real-world clinical and operational processes into configured, pre-built workflow templates inside Harmony Workflow, working hand-in-hand with the Consensus product team through agile sprints to prioritize, build, and refine platform enhancements. You will also partner directly with co-design and early adopter customers to validate, adapt, and launch new workflows in production — ensuring what we build reflects how care teams actually operate. This role reports to the VP of Healthcare Solutions and collaborates closely with Product Management, Engineering, Implementation, and Customer Success.

The value you will deliver…

  • Clinically Adjacent Workflow Design & Pre-Build:
  • Design and pre-build segment-specific workflow templates in Harmony Workflow for imaging, oncology, and post-acute referral management (SNF, home care, and rehab), grounded in real clinical and operational processes.
  • Translate referral, intake, scheduling, authorization, and care-coordination steps into structured, automated workflow logic that reflects how clinicians and care teams actually work.
  • Maintain a library of reusable, configurable workflow templates by segment that can be rapidly adapted for new customers and use cases.
  • Identify workflow gaps, edge cases, and exception paths (e.g., urgent referrals, denials, missing clinical documentation) and design handling for each within the platform.
  • Product Collaboration & Agile Development:
  • Partner with the Consensus product team as an embedded clinical subject matter expert throughout the agile sprint cycle — backlog grooming, sprint planning, story writing, and acceptance criteria.
  • Translate clinical workflow requirements into detailed user stories and acceptance criteria that engineering can build against.
  • Participate in sprint reviews and demos, providing clinical validation and feedback on new Harmony Workflow features and enhancements.
  • Help prioritize the product roadmap by surfacing the highest-impact workflow gaps and opportunities from the field.
  • Co-Design & Early Adopter Customer Engagement:
  • Work directly with co-design and early adopter customers to understand their existing clinical and operational workflows for imaging, oncology, and post-acute referral management.
  • Lead workflow discovery sessions with clinical and operational stakeholders (referral coordinators, care managers, schedulers, clinicians) to map current-state processes and design future-state workflows in Harmony.
  • Configure, test, and iterate on customer-specific workflow builds in partnership with implementation and engineering, ensuring a smooth path from design to go-live.
  • Gather structured feedback from early adopters and feed it back into the product team to refine templates and platform capabilities.
  • Clinical Subject Matter Expertise:
  • Serve as a real-world practice workflow voice on the HSS team, ensuring workflow design decisions reflect sound judgment and real-world care delivery.
  • Support Sales, Marketing, and Professional Services with clinical context, workflow demonstrations, and segment-specific expertise during the sales and implementation lifecycle.
  • Stay current on clinical and operational trends within imaging, oncology, and post-acute care to inform workflow design and roadmap priorities.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as required, assigned, or requested. Consensus reserves the right to add or change duties at any time.

What you will bring to the table…

  • Some level of clinical expertise is preferred: NP, PA, LPN
  • BA degree required. Advanced clinical degree desired.
  • 3+ years experience working in a high volume specialty practice environment - such as medical imaging, ambulatory oncology, cardiology, etc.
  • Direct experience with referral management, care coordination, prior authorization, or care transitions in a hospital, health system, or post-acute setting.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex clinical workflows into structured, logical process design (e.g., workflow diagrams, process maps, configuration logic).
  • Comfort working in an agile product environment — sprint ceremonies, user stories, and iterative build-and-feedback cycles.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage credibly with clinicians, operational leaders, and technical product/engineering teams.
  • Willingness to travel to customer sites for discovery and co-design sessions.

You will stand out if you also have…

  • Clinical background - as a RN, NP, PA, or LPN.
  • Experience with workflow automation, orchestration, or no-code/low-code configuration platforms.
  • Prior experience in health IT, clinical informatics, or a solutions/implementation role at a healthcare technology company.
  • Experience working with Epic or other major EHRs (Oracle Health, Meditech) is preferred but not required, including how clinical workflows interact with them.
  • Experience serving as a subject matter expert supporting product development (user research, requirements gathering, UAT).
  • Advanced degree (MSN, DNP, or a PA-specific graduate degree) or additional certification in case management, care coordination, or informatics.
  • Experience specifically in imaging/radiology operations, oncology navigation, or post-acute discharge planning.

Additional details…

  • Location requirements: Fully remote within the U.S.
  • Travel requirements: Up to 10% travel.
  • Physical requirements: Must be able to sit for long periods, as well as, handle long periods of screen time.
  • Technology requirements: Reliable, high speed internet.
  • Eligible for sponsorship: No


The salary range for this role is $180,000.00 - $190,000.00 USD annually. The total compensation package for this position is negotiable and may also include annual performance bonus, ESPP, enhanced time off packages and benefits. This job doesn't have an expiration date and will remain open until a qualified candidate is hired.

We are not accepting agency submissions for this role.

To learn more about us visit consensus.com

About the Company

At Torc, we have always believed that autonomous vehicle technology will transform how we travel, move freight, and do business.
A leader in autonomous driving since 2007, Torc has spent over a decade commercializing our solutions with experienced partners. Now a part of the Daimler family, we are focused solely on developing software for automated trucks to transform how the world moves freight.
Join us and catapult your career with the company that helped pioneer autonomous technology, and the first AV software company with the vision to partner directly with a truck manufacturer.

Meet the Team

The Senior Autonomy Core Frameworks Software Engineer plays a critical role in architecting and advancing the foundational frameworks that underpin Torc's autonomous driving stack. This role helps in owning technical direction for the software in core autonomy components, helping to raise the bar on code quality, and driving improvements across the autonomy software.

As a senior technical leader, you will collaborate closely with the Behavior and Perception teams within Autonomy to design robust, composable architectural patterns that serve as the foundation for safe, performant, reliable autonomous operation. This position demands deep technical expertise in software architecture and autonomous vehicle fundamentals.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the architecture, design, implementation, and evolution of core frameworks that serve as the foundation for Torc's autonomous driving stack, including state management, inter-component communication, abstraction layers, and common utilities used across all software systems.
  • Drive the technical direction for real-time C++ architectural components and patterns responsible for reliable system-wide data flow, component coordination, error handling, and operational observability.
  • Establish scalable architectural patterns and abstractions that enable autonomous driving capabilities while driving technical tradeoff discussions and long-term design decisions that shape the entire platform.
  • Collaborate across Behavior and Perception teams to keep integration boundaries clean and shared abstractions coherent.
  • Lead architecture reviews, design discussions, and code reviews while establishing engineering standards that improve reliability, maintainability, testability, and scalability across the platform.
  • Mentor software engineers through technical coaching, architectural guidance, and day-to-day collaboration while raising engineering standards and fostering technical excellence across the organization.
  • Champion architectural quality through systematic validation, comprehensive testing strategies, observability frameworks, and production readiness practices that ensure platform robustness at scale.
  • Contribute to root cause analysis of complex platform-level issues and drive architectural improvements that enhance system reliability, performance, and operational resilience.
  • Define and evolve simulation and validation frameworks that enable rigorous testing of core architectural components across diverse operational scenarios and edge cases.
  • Evaluate emerging architectural patterns, systems research, and advanced techniques that can strengthen the platform's foundation and enable future autonomous driving capabilities.
  • Communicate complex architectural concepts and technical vision effectively across engineering teams, product, and leadership while building consensus around platform direction and technical strategy.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or related technical discipline with 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, or
  • Master's degree with 6+ years of professional experience, or
  • Demonstrated success designing and evolving complex, production software platforms with ownership of architectural decisions
  • Deep experienced with C++17 and recent standards
  • Comfortable with using Python to help script and glue systems together
  • Experience working across autonomous systems/robotics, distributed systems, or complex embedded environments using middleware with pub-sub communications patterns
  • Strong experience with testing, continuous integration, and build systems
  • Deep experience with systems-level software design, including experience managing technical debt, refactoring large codebases, and evolving platforms while maintaining stability and performance.
  • Experience mentoring engineers through technical leadership, architecture reviews, code reviews, and establishing engineering standards that scale across organizations.
  • Strong mastery of software engineering fundamentals including modular/composable architecture, design patterns, concurrency, testing strategies, and long-term maintainability.

Bonus Points

  • Experience architecting, maintaining, and using robotics middleware's (E.g., ROS 2)
  • Deep expertise in distributed systems design, including consensus algorithms, state synchronization, event-driven architectures, deterministic replay, etc.
  • Familiarity with ISO 26262, SOTIF, ASPICE, or other safety-critical software development standards.
  • Experience with GitHub Actions and Jenkins
  • Experience with Bazel and Bazel-based build systems
  • Experience designing or building observability, logging, and monitoring systems for complex distributed systems.
  • Experience working with simulations for regression testing
  • Experience managing versioning and conversion of data schemas at scale

Perks of Being a Full-time Torc’r
Torc cares about our team members and we strive to provide benefits and resources to support their health, work/life balance, and future. Our culture is collaborative, energetic, and team focused. Torc offers:

  • A competitive compensation package that includes a bonus component and stock options
  • 100% paid medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees
  • 401K plan with a 6% employer match
  • Flexibility in schedule and generous paid vacation (available immediately after start date)
  • AD+D and Life Insurance

At Torc, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We celebrate the uniqueness of our Torc’rs and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, or disabilities.
Even if you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications listed for this opportunity, we encourage you to apply.

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several geographic markets. Pay is based on a number of factors and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Torc's total compensation package will also include our corporate bonus and stock option plan. Dependent on the position offered, sign-on payments, relocation, and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits.

Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections.

The Avaya Infinity™ platform unifies fragmented customer experiences, connecting the channels, insights, technologies, and workflows that together create enduring customer and employee relationships.

We believe success is built through strong connections – with each other, with our work, and with our mission. At Avaya, you'll find a community that values your contributions and supports your growth every step of the way.

Learn more at

Position Overview

We are looking for a hands-on software engineer with strong system design skills, deep server-side engineering experience, and the curiosity to work across a complex enterprise platform. You will turn product and engineering goals into practical designs, implement critical functionality, and carry improvements through testing, deployment, and production operation.

You should enjoy understanding how components work together, exploring unfamiliar codebases, and tracing problems beyond the boundaries of a single service. The role combines broad technical judgment with the ability and motivation to go deep into implementation details.

jobs.excerpt: About AutoRABITAutoRABIT helps organizations, particularly those in highly regulated industries, modernize and secure how they develop, release, and manage change across Salesforce environments.
jobs.description:
About AutoRABIT

AutoRABIT helps organizations, particularly those in highly regulated industries, modernize and secure how they develop, release, and manage change across Salesforce environments. Our platform helps teams improve release velocity, strengthen security and governance, reduce manual processes, and build more reliable software delivery practices.

The Role

As a Customer Success Manager, you will own a portfolio of strategic, enterprise, and technically complex customers. This is a highly technical Customer Success role working with Salesforce, DevOps, Engineering, Platform, Security, and executive stakeholders to understand each customer's development lifecycle, deployment processes, technical environment, and business objectives.

CSMs are expected to operate as trusted technical and strategic advisors. You should be comfortable discussing Salesforce DevOps, CI/CD, source control, release management, testing, security, governance, and software delivery practices, while connecting those topics to measurable customer outcomes. You are not expected to replace a Solutions Engineer or Salesforce Architect, but you should have enough technical depth to independently lead discovery, identify risks and opportunities, challenge customers when appropriate, and engage specialized resources when needed.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own a portfolio of strategic and technically complex customers, with accountability for adoption, customer health, value realization, renewal readiness, and growth.
  • Build trusted relationships with Salesforce administrators, developers, architects, DevOps leaders, platform owners, engineering leaders, and executive sponsors.
  • Develop a strong understanding of each customer's Salesforce development lifecycle, including source control, environments, testing, release management, deployments, and governance.
  • Assess customer DevOps practices and identify technical barriers, process gaps, adoption challenges, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Lead technical and strategic discovery to understand how customers operate, where friction exists, and what outcomes they are trying to achieve.
  • Apply knowledge of Salesforce DevOps and software delivery best practices to help customers improve adoption and realize measurable value.
  • Create success plans with clear business and technical objectives, milestones, adoption goals, and success measures.
  • Proactively identify customer risk, diagnose root causes, and lead recovery plans across technical and business stakeholders.
  • Coordinate resources across Solutions Engineering, Support, Professional Services, Product, Engineering, Sales, Renewals, and leadership to resolve complex customer challenges.
  • Guide customers through major technical milestones, including implementations, upgrades, new capabilities, process changes, and evolving Salesforce environments.
  • Identify opportunities to expand AutoRABIT's value based on customer use cases, technical maturity, and business objectives.
  • Bring customer insights, technical patterns, and product feedback back to Product and Engineering.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Strong understanding of modern DevOps principles, CI/CD practices, and the software development lifecycle.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce development and deployment concepts, including metadata, environments, testing, dependencies, release management, and common deployment challenges.
  • Strong working knowledge of Git and source control concepts, including branches, commits, merges, pull requests, and repositories.
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, release automation, APIs, testing, security, and governance.
  • Ability to understand technical architectures and customer workflows, identify areas of risk or friction, and recommend appropriate next steps.
  • Ability to independently conduct technical discovery and move beyond surface-level requirements to uncover root causes.
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes for executive and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with engineering performance concepts and metrics, including DORA metrics.
  • Strong executive presence, communication, presentation, and problem-solving skills.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of relevant professional experience across Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Solutions Engineering, Salesforce consulting, Professional Services, DevOps, or other customer-facing enterprise technology roles.
  • 2+ years supporting technically complex enterprise customers in developer tools, DevOps, Salesforce, cloud platforms, or similar enterprise software.
  • Demonstrated experience working with senior technical stakeholders across Engineering, DevOps, Salesforce, IT, or CTO organizations.
  • Strong technical background with Salesforce development, Salesforce DevOps, CI/CD, release management, or comparable software delivery processes.
  • Experience managing complex enterprise accounts, customer risk, technical initiatives, and cross-functional account teams.
  • Experience supporting Fortune 500 or similarly complex organizations preferred.
  • Experience within Financial Services, Healthcare, Government, or other regulated industries preferred.

What Success Looks Like

Successful CSMs understand not only whether customers are using AutoRABIT, but how they build and deliver software on Salesforce, where technical and operational friction exists, and how AutoRABIT can help improve those processes. They can independently engage with technical practitioners and leaders, ask informed questions, identify risks and opportunities, and connect improvements in DevOps practices to measurable business and engineering outcomes.

Additional Information

This role is fully remote and is open to candidates based in Australia with Australian work eligibility.

This role is fully remote with 10% travel required.

Salary Range: $115,000 - $130,000 AUD per year, depending on experience.

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer - Tools & Activation
jobs.excerpt: Hello.  We're Prismic. We believe the future is all about autonomous websites and hyper-personalised user journeys.
jobs.description:
Hello. We're Prismic.

We believe the future is all about autonomous websites and hyper-personalised user journeys.

We're building the Autonomous Website Experience. Today you choose tools, model content, write code, and fix bugs by hand. Tomorrow you say what you want, and the system builds, fixes, and improves the site with you, from the first demo to the daily updates.

The Tools and Activation Team

Our mission: build the tools that let developers, marketers, and AI agents, use Prismic efficiently, and design the most frictionless onboarding for different personalities and personas.

We own two sides of that problem.

  • The tools. The CLI and MCP are how agents work with Prismic. An agent in Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, or Codex should be able to do everything you can do in the UI, without guessing, getting stuck, or inventing glue code. The developer tooling is what closes the loop - how developers deliver slices and manage their day to day work. We make those surfaces reliable, complete, and efficient.

  • The first mile. People don't just arrive from different places. They also arrive with different experience and different knowledge of Prismic. Everyone should be able to onboard. We design those paths for that range of people, and we are responsible for making them the best.

What we measure

We measure two things.

Activation with our tools. How many developers and agents activate with the MCP, whether they stay, and how often they come back.

Onboarding to production. How many people start with Prismic and deploy their website to production.

The problems you'd pick up

Here's what's actually on the table right now.

CLI and MCP that make humans and agents first-class users of Prismic. The CLI is how agents set up projects, model content, and stay in the codebase. The MCP is how they read, edit, and operate on content. Together they should cover the full surface of the product, not a thin slice of it. The hard part is not exposing an API. It is making people and agents efficient: the right tools, the right defaults, the right errors, and a path that doesn't fall apart past the happy path.

Developer tooling that stays out of the way. This is how developers actually interact with Prismic day to day: scaffolding projects, modeling data, developing Slices and syncing with remote server. You would help shape that interactions so people can do their work without fighting the tool.

Onboarding that works for different people. People arrive from different sources and they arrive with very different experience. All of them should be able to onboard. You would help design those paths and keep them coherent.

Why this role is interesting

  • You build the technology, and you build it fast. We prototype quickly, learn from it, and keep what works. An idea goes from POC to something customers use without a long chain of handoffs.

  • You talk to customers directly. Product Engineers here don't wait for a spec. You talk to users, decide what to build, ship it, and see whether it moved the numbers.

  • Your users are humans and agents. Designing for developers, marketers, and AI agents at once is a new problem. There is no established playbook, so you help write it.

  • Your impact is easy to see. Activation and websites in production are numbers you can watch move because of what you shipped.

Role 💫

We're looking for a Senior Product Engineer to join the Tools and Activation Team.

We chose the title Product Engineer on purpose. We're not looking for someone who ships clean code against a spec. We want someone who owns the outcome: talks to users, decides what to build with product, ships it, and is accountable for whether it moved the numbers. It's less about handoffs and more about owning the work end to end.

This is an individual contributor role. You'll have a lot of autonomy over both product and technical decisions, while working closely with product, design, and the rest of the engineering team.

Are you the one? 🧠

This role leans backend. You will spend most of your time on services, APIs and CLIs. Frontend is part of the job when the path to activation lives in a UI, but it is not the centre of gravity.

Ideally, you:

  • Are a strong backend engineer in TypeScript, comfortable designing APIs and CLIs

  • Have built developer-facing surfaces like CLIs or SDKs. You’re used to commands that compose, contracts that stay stable, output that tells you what to do next, and errors specific enough to recover from.

  • Have built agent-facing surfaces before. The client of our products is not always a human. Agents get stuck on interactive prompts, vague errors, and incomplete tools. You understand the problems and know how to solve them.

  • Are at home with ambiguous problems and short feedback loops. You can take an idea to a POC quickly, learn from it, and decide what to keep.

You also bring the baseline every Product Engineer here shares:

  • You're full-stack enough to work across the stack when the problem requires it, including databases and infrastructure.

  • You handle complex integrations and product problems without waiting to be told what to do.

  • You have hands-on experience with agentic AI systems, or strong curiosity about them.

  • You care about quality engineering: testing, observability, traceability.

We weigh competencies over years of experience or job titles.

Bonus points

  • You've shipped or maintained an MCP server, or a CLI designed for both humans and agents.

  • You've worked on developer experience in a product company.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We care about how you think, how you build, and how you raise the level of the system around you.

Technologies and tools we use daily

  • TypeScript (NodeJS)

  • React

  • AWS

  • SST

  • Serverless architecture

  • PostgreSQL

  • LangChain / LangGraph

  • Playwright / Vitest

  • GitHub Actions

  • Cursor / Claude Code / Codex

How we hire

Our process tests what the job actually involves.

  1. Intro call with our talent partner.

  2. Technical exercise - you'll work in TypeScript, and we look at async behaviour and code quality alongside the AI-specific parts.

  3. System design. Deliberately not AI-specific. We want to see how you think about APIs, servers, databases, and architecture in general.

  4. Meet the team, including your future manager.

You're welcome to use AI tools throughout. That's how we work, so it's how we interview.

What are the perks? 🎉

  • MacBook: get top-notch tech to work with.

  • Home office budget: set up your ideal workspace.

  • Yoga classes: online and onsite, 3x a week.

  • Yearly company gatherings to connect with international teams.

Other benefits may depend on the country you're based in.

Work across borders. Come together in Paris 🌍

We’re an international team, with Paris as our hub for collaboration and connection. Every quarter, everyone at Prismic meets in Paris for our In-Office Week. To build together, share ideas and have fun as a team. Attendance is expected, with dates shared well in advance so everyone can plan.

You’ll work from your country of employment, with arrangements depending on your role and location:

  • Based in Paris: join us in the office once a week.

  • Elsewhere in France: join us in Paris once a month.

  • Outside France: work primarily remotely, alongside our quarterly Paris get-togethers.

Ready to help build the future of the web?

Apply now to become a Senior Product Engineer at Prismic and help us make publishing a team effort.

We're primarily hiring at the Senior level, but we're also open to mid-level engineers with strong ownership who are already comfortable taking on ambiguous problems and driving work end to end.

We can't wait to see what you'll bring to the Collaboration Squad.

Highlights

Senior Product Engineer, Collaboration: Remote (Europe), own Page Builder editing experience, including real-time collaboration & interactive live preview. Full-stack, high autonomy, AI-native team.

Preferred Qualifications

  2. Advanced knowledge of US and international standards including ASTM, AMS, AWS, NADCAP, NACE/AMPP, and SSPC.
  3. Current or prior AWS Certified Welding Inspector (CWI) credentials, or equivalent metallurgical certification.
  4. Proven experience in metallographic analysis, heat treatment evaluation, weld inspection, and industrial coating assessment.

A LITTLE BIT ABOUT Boldr

  • Boldr is the first global B-Corp dedicated to delivering world-class Client experiences while creating access to dignified, meaningful work in communities around the world.
  • We are a global team, united by our desire to connect diverse people with common values for boldr impact.

LET’S START WITH OUR VALUES

  • Excellent. Being excellent at what we do sets us apart. It happens when we care about our work and how it lands, set clear standards, and hold each other accountable. We don't stop at meeting the standard; we keep raising the bar.
  • Authentic. Real connection happens when we show up as our best, truest selves, help others do the same, and stand by each other through the harder times.
  • Curious. Curiosity keeps us innovative. Better understanding comes from asking helpful questions, seeking to understand before we act, and building on each other's thinking.
  • Dynamic. Growth is central to our purpose, and it only happens in dynamic environments where we stay flexible, adaptable and open.
  • Empathetic. Great partnerships happen when we take the time to understand the people we work with, our teams, our clients and our communities, for better outcomes for each.

WHAT IS YOUR ROLE

As a Platform Engineering Specialist, you build and run the internal platform that Boldr teams use to ship software safely. You lead our cloud foundations, delivery pipelines and platform security, sharing ownership with the team so more than one person can always run them, so that engineers and non-engineers who build with AI can deploy to secure, governed environments without having to become infrastructure experts.

You will design the paved road: AWS environments, CI/CD, environment promotion, automated security checks, access control and observability. You will work with the Product lead and engineers who build on the platform, turn their needs into reusable tooling, and share your infrastructure knowledge across the team.

You are also a full-stack engineer. Alongside platform work, you will build and ship features across our web applications, APIs and integrations with the rest of the Product team, and pick up whatever the current priority needs.

This is a hands-on senior role. You set direction for your area, make sound technical calls on your own, and are accountable for the reliability, security and cost of the platform and the quality of the code you ship.

You'll be working with the Product Team Lead to deliver technical solutions to deliver Boldrific platform solutions. You will collaborate with producing design decisions, supporting team members on shared goals, and providing guidance on engineering best practices across the Product team to deliver solutions for internal and external stakeholders.

WHY DO WE WANT YOU

We are currently looking for impact-driven individuals who are passionate in helping Boldr grow and achieve our Purpose. We expect our Team to become our ultimate partners to success by always giving their 110% in everything, sharing their talents and quirks, and championing our core values: Curious, Dynamic and Authentic.

WHAT WILL YOU DO

Full-stack product engineering

  • Design, build and maintain web applications, API services, serverless functions and scheduled background jobs, front end and back end.
  • Build custom RESTful APIs, middleware and third-party integrations using webhooks, websockets and queues.
  • Design and manage databases, and work with data teams to improve software functionality.
  • Own projects end to end across the Software Development Life Cycle, from design to deployment.
  • Debug production issues, find root causes and tell code problems apart from data problems.
  • Test and optimize applications for performance and user experience.
  • Review code to enforce coding standards and engineering best practices.

Cloud Foundations

Delivery and environments

  • Build reusable CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) that teams can adopt by default.
  • Design environment promotion across personal dev, sandbox and production, with automated checks that block promotion when they fail.
  • Automate app provisioning: build, database, health checks, sign-in checks and DNS.

Platform security and access

  • Own the security posture of our GitHub organization: access, branch and Actions policy, OIDC federation to AWS, and secret scanning.
  • Integrate security, secrets and sensitive-data scanning into the delivery path.
  • Work with our central identity provider to give every deployed app consistent authentication and access control.

Reliability and operations

  • Set up logging, monitoring and alerting across platform environments.
  • Lead incident response for platform issues, find root causes and prevent repeats.
  • Write and maintain runbooks and platform documentation that other people can follow.
  • Cross-train teammates so platform work is shared, and prepare areas for handover to future team members.

Team and ways of working

  • Creative and solutions-oriented

YOU HAVE…

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Metronome is the leading usage-based billing platform built for modern software companies. With Metronome, now a Stripe product, companies can launch products faster, offer any pricing model, and streamline finance workflows without writing code.

Our platform computes hundreds of millions of invoices per billing period and continues to scale rapidly to accommodate new customers. We save them days of development time and manual invoicing, enabling them to use their billing data to better serve their customers. Our customers love our product and approach, and we’re humbled to work with amazing companies like OpenAI, Anthropic, NVIDIA, TogetherAI, HuggingFace, and many others.

You'll be joining an experienced team that includes founders who have successfully built and sold startups before. Our Stripes have direct experience building and scaling teams through massive growth at companies like Dropbox, Palantir, and MongoDB. You'll be joining Stripe and be part of the holistic Stripe platform approaching monetization.

What you’ll do

The Metronome AI Native Solutions team operates at the intersection of technical sales, implementation, and customer success, purpose-built for the velocity and unique needs of AI-first companies. Unlike traditional sales engineering roles, this position owns the large parts of if not all of the deal cycle - from first call through technical win - and gets hands-on with implementation to ensure customers go live quickly.

As an AI Native Solutions Architect, you'll be the primary technical owner for fast-moving AI companies that may need to launch usage-based billing on tight timelines. This means:

Owning the technical win:

  • Taking qualified inbound leads and driving them through discovery, demo, POC, and technical win
  • Using efficient discovery to quickly understand billing challenges, product launch timelines, and technical requirements
  • Bringing energy and urgency to every engagement—proactively driving deals forward, identifying blockers early, and building relationships across the customer organization (engineering, finance, product) to create champions
  • Running streamlined demos tailored to technical founders and product/engineering teams

Driving hands-on implementation:

  • Providing customers with clear, actionable implementation plans to implement their usage-based billing launches
  • Writing code snippets, configuration examples, and integration guides to accelerate customer time-to-value
  • Pair programming or working alongside customer teams during POCs and initial setup
  • Designing up/downstream integrations into prospect systems with a bias toward pragmatic solutions that get them live quickly

Building deep AI market expertise:

  • Building relationships with technical founders, engineering leaders, product, and finance teams at AI companies
  • Understanding the unique monetization challenges facing LLM providers, generative AI companies (image, video, audio), and AI tooling/wrapper companies and providing consultative guidance when prospects need direction on pricing and packaging strategy and implementation
  • Staying current on AI industry trends, pricing models, and competitive dynamics

This role is perfect for someone who thrives in high-velocity environments, loves solving technical problems in real-time, and wants to be on the front lines of how AI companies monetize their products. Metronome directly influences how the next generation of AI infrastructure gets built—and our AI Native Solutions team drives this influence with our fastest-growing customer segment.

The Metronome team still operates very much like a startup. As such, there's a lot still to figure out and tremendous room for high-agency, curious individuals to impact our direction and strategy, build processes from zero to one, and generally make a difference. If this excites you as much as it excites us, let's talk.

Who you are

This is roughly the set of things we’re looking for - if you’re interested in this role and don’t meet some of these on paper, err on the side of applying!

Minimum requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in technical, customer-facing roles involving SaaS products (for example, sales engineering, solutions architecture, technical account management, implementation consulting)
  • Experience working with, at, or selling to AI companies - you understand how AI-first companies operate, their unique challenges, and the market landscape
  • Proven ability to own and drive customer-facing engagements and relationships independently
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to quickly learn new systems, write code snippets, and guide technical implementations
  • Experience working in high-velocity environments where speed-to-value matters and customers need to launch quickly
  • Excellent communication skills with technical buyers (engineers, product managers, technical founders)

Preferred qualifications

  • Deep knowledge of the quote-to-cash space, including integrating with or otherwise interacting with tools like Salesforce, NetSuite, CPQs, etc.
  • Experience as a software engineer, product manager, or in other technical roles.
  • Experience in a pure sales role, particularly selling to technical buyers in engineering and product organizations or selling as a founding or early salesperson at a startup.
  • Familiarity and enthusiasm for AI developer tooling (Cursor, Lovable, Vercel, LangChain, etc.) and the broader AI infrastructure ecosystem

This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of AI monetization at one of the world's leading fintech companies. Join us in defining how the next generation of AI businesses will scale and succeed.

jobs.excerpt: About Vesta Vesta helps wireless providers make more money byimprovinga part of theirbusinessmostdon’tthink about — payments.
jobs.description:
About Vesta

Vesta helps wireless providers make more money byimprovinga part of theirbusinessmostdon’tthink about — payments. Vesta works with major names like AT&T, Rogers, Telcel, and Vodafone, helping them stop fraud, reduce failed transactions, and make sure moretransactions are successful. ForMNOs,MVNOs and prepaid carriers, this can mean fewer lost customers and more revenue — all without adding friction to the checkout experience. With over 100 million transactions processed every year in 40+ countries, Vestahelpswireless providers turn their payment systems into a competitive advantage.

Note: This is a 6-12 month Contract Position.

Position Summary

Vesta Corporation is seeking a Senior Network Engineer to lead the design, implementation, and ongoing operations of our global enterprise network. This is a senior individual-contributor role operating at the intersection of complex multi-site networking, hybrid cloud infrastructure, and PCI compliance. The ideal candidate brings 10+ years of hands-on enterprise networking experience, deep fluency with AWS network architecture and security services, strong familiarity with both commercial and open-source tooling, and the ability to drive infrastructure modernization initiatives with limited oversight.

Key Responsibilities

On-Premises & Hybrid Network Infrastructure

  • Design, implement, and maintain scalable, secure network infrastructure across data centers, remote sites, and AWS/Azure cloud environments.
  • Architect and operate routing and switching infrastructure including BGP, NAT, VLANs, Spanning Tree, IPsec VPNs and HSRP.
  • Manage and tune enterprise firewall platforms (Cisco, pfSense, Check Point) in alignment with PCI DSS segmentation and access control requirements.
  • Administer and optimize F5 BIG-IP LTM/GTM for application delivery, load balancing, and traffic steering across production environments.
  • Manage Cloudflare DNS, WAF, and network security policies for internet-facing properties.
  • Maintain network security policy management via FireMon; contribute to access path analysis and rule lifecycle management.
  • Manage Proxmox-based virtualization as it relates to network-adjacent workloads and VM/LXC networking.
  • Coordinate with vendors and carriers to manage WAN circuits, resolve outages, and drive cost optimization.

AWS Network Design & Operations

  • Design, deploy, and maintain AWS Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs) including subnet design, CIDR allocation, route tables, internet gateways, and NAT gateways across multi-account and multi-region environments.
  • Architect and manage VPC-to-VPC connectivity via VPC Peering, AWS Transit Gateway, and PrivateLink to support secure, scalable inter-service communication.
  • Configure and maintain AWS Site-to-Site VPN and Direct Connect circuits for hybrid connectivity between on-premises data centers and AWS environments.
  • Design and enforce AWS Security Group and Network ACL policies as network-layer access controls, aligned with PCI DSS segmentation requirements.
  • Manage DNS architecture within AWS using Route 53 for private hosted zones, resolver endpoints, conditional forwarding, and DNS failover across hybrid environments.
  • Configure and manage AWS NAT Gateways, Elastic IPs, and Elastic Load Balancers (ALB/NLB) for workload exposure and traffic routing.
  • Maintain AWS network connectivity for partner data and compute workloads migrated into cloud environments, including GDPR and data sovereignty considerations.

AWS Security & Compliance

  • Implement and maintain AWS security controls at the network layer including Security Groups, NACLs, VPC Flow Logs, and WAF rulesets on CloudFront and ALB.
  • Enable and manage AWS CloudTrail across accounts to ensure comprehensive API activity logging; integrate with centralized SIEM for alerting and audit evidence.
  • Configure and maintain AWS GuardDuty for threat detection; triage findings and drive remediation in coordination with the security team.
  • Manage AWS Security Hub to aggregate and prioritize findings from GuardDuty, Inspector, Macie, and third-party integrations; produce compliance posture reports for PCI DSS and SOC 1 Type 2 audits.
  • Administer AWS IAM policies, roles, and permission boundaries as they relate to network resource access; enforce least-privilege principles across VPC, Direct Connect, and Transit Gateway configurations.
  • Use AWS Config rules and AWS Organizations SCPs to enforce network security standards and detect drift across multi-account environments.

Monitoring, Observability & Automation

  • Monitor AWS network health using VPC Flow Logs, CloudWatch metrics and alarms, Transit Gateway Network Manager, and Reachability Analyzer.
  • Build and maintain CloudWatch dashboards and alarms for network throughput, latency, NAT gateway utilization, VPN tunnel status, and Direct Connect metrics.
  • Evaluate, deploy, and operationalize FOSS tools as replacements for commercial products where appropriate (e.g., Oxidized, NetBox)
  • Contribute to Infrastructure as Code for network resources using automation; enforce configuration consistency across environments.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation for network topology, configurations, and operational runbooks; support PCI DSS and SOC 1 Type 2 audit evidence collection.
  • Participate in on-call rotation and be available for after-hours work including unscheduled incidents.
  • Travel to domestic data center and office locations as needed to support deployments or incidents.

Technical Expertise & Core Competencies

Required On-Premises

  • 10+ years of hands-on enterprise networking experience in large-scale, multi-site environments.
  • Expert-level Cisco routing and switching: IOS/NX-OS, BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, VLANs, STP, QoS.
  • Enterprise firewall administration: Cisco ASA/FTD, pfSense, and Check Point. Rule management, segmentation strategy, and change control.
  • F5 BIG-IP LTM/GTM: virtual servers, pools, iRules, traffic policies, and GTM topology records.
  • Cloudflare: DNS management, WAF rulesets, and security policy administration.
  • FireMon: policy analysis, rule review workflows, and access path validation.
  • Deep understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing/switching protocols, and secure remote access.
  • Experience operating in PCI DSS compliant environments including control implementation and audit evidence collection.

Required AWS Networking & Security:

  • VPC architecture: subnet design and CIDR planning, route tables, internet gateways, NAT gateways, and VPC endpoints.
  • VPC connectivity: VPC Peering, Transit Gateway, and AWS PrivateLink for inter-VPC and cross-account routing.
  • Hybrid connectivity: Site-to-Site VPN and Direct Connect configuration, BGP peering, and failover design.
  • Security controls: Security Groups, Network ACLs, and VPC Flow Logs for traffic visibility and PCI segmentation enforcement.
  • DNS: Route 53 private hosted zones, resolver endpoints, conditional forwarding rules, and health-check-based failover.
  • Load balancing and exposure: Application Load Balancer (ALB), Network Load Balancer (NLB), and Elastic IP management.
  • Monitoring and observability: CloudWatch metrics, alarms, dashboards; VPC Flow Logs analysis; Transit Gateway Network Manager.
  • Security and compliance services: CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub, AWS Config, IAM policy review, and ACM.
  • Multi-account governance: AWS Organizations, SCPs, and Control Tower network guardrails.

Preferred / Nice to Have

  • Proxmox VE: VM/LXC provisioning, cluster management, and software-defined networking.
  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform or CloudFormation for network resource provisioning and drift detection.
  • Experience deploying FOSS tools to replace commercial networking or monitoring products (e.g., Oxidized, NetBox).
  • Azure networking: Azure Firewall, NSGs, and Azure DNS private zones.
  • Zero-trust / overlay VPN concepts and implementation (e.g., Tailscale or Wireguard).
  • AWS advanced networking: CloudFront distributions, WAF on ALB/CloudFront, PrivateLink endpoint services, Network Firewall.
  • Scripting or automation: Python, Bash, or Ansible for network task automation.
  • Vendor management: circuit provisioning, carrier escalations, and hardware lifecycle coordination.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of enterprise networking experience in complex, multi-site or global environments.
  • Demonstrated hands-on proficiency with AWS networking and security services in production environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and drive projects to completion without heavy oversight.
  • Strong vendor management skills, able to coordinate service delivery and incident resolution with carriers, ISPs, and hardware vendors.
  • Proven ability to document infrastructure for audits, incident response, and operational continuity.
  • Willingness and ability to travel domestically as needed (valid driver’s license required).
  • Available for on-call rotation and after-hours support windows.

Education & Certifications

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Required Certifications

  • Cisco CCNP (or higher) Enterprise, Data Center, or Security track.

Preferred Certifications

  • AWS Certified Advanced Networking, Specialty (ANS-C01) or AWS Solutions Architect | Professional.
  • AWS Certified Security, Specialty (SCS) is a strong differentiator given the compliance posture of this role.
  • Microsoft Azure Network Engineer Associate or equivalent Azure networking certification.
  • Check Point CCSE or equivalent firewall platform certification.
  • CCIE (any track), F5 Certified BIG-IP Administrator, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, or other advanced certifications.

jobs.description:
Location: 100% Remote
Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve our engineering workflows, and build practical knowledge across the team.

We are looking for a senior developer who can take ownership of iOS development, deliver reliable software, and help our team become more effective at building applications with AI.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior iOS App Developer with an excellent background in native iOS development using Swift and SwiftUI, together with practical experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into iOS applications.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will develop and improve our iOS application, integrate shared application logic, solve complex technical problems, and establish effective workflows for AI-assisted and agentic development.

Experience with GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or related location and proximity technologies would be particularly valuable.

You will also share your knowledge with our internal team, including mentoring a junior team member who is learning to build mobile applications through AI-assisted development, often referred to as “vibe coding.”

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and improve our native iOS application using Swift and SwiftUI.
  • Integrate Kotlin Multiplatform modules into the iOS application and collaborate on shared business logic.
  • Implement platform-specific functionality while maintaining consistent behavior across iOS and Android.
  • Implement and troubleshoot location and proximity features involving GPS, BLE, UWB, and related device capabilities.
  • Address practical iOS challenges such as permissions, application lifecycle, background execution, battery consumption, and device compatibility.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents extensively to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and support testing.
  • Set up and improve agentic development workflows, including task decomposition, project context, automated checks, and review processes.
  • Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
  • Test relevant functionality on real devices and investigate issues that automated tests alone may not reveal.
  • Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and clear explanations.
  • Support application signing, release preparation, and distribution through TestFlight and the App Store.
  • Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production iOS applications.
  • Excellent practical knowledge of Swift, SwiftUI, and the iOS development ecosystem.
  • Practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform and its integration into native iOS applications.
  • Solid understanding of application architecture, asynchronous programming, lifecycle management, and state management.
  • Strong debugging skills across application code, shared modules, APIs, and device behavior.
  • Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
  • A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
  • The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain technical decisions.
  • Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly.
  • The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • GPS positioning, location accuracy, geofencing, and sensor data.
  • BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and proximity detection.
  • UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility.
  • NFC and other device-to-device interactions.
  • Interoperability between Swift and Kotlin Multiplatform, including asynchronous operations and error handling.
  • Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • Ownership of meaningful iOS development work.
  • The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents.
  • Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your role in developing and releasing iOS applications.
  • Your experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into native iOS projects.
  • Any practical experience with GPS, BLE, UWB, or similar technologies.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with an example of how they helped you deliver a working application or feature.
  • Your experience mentoring junior developers or colleagues learning AI-assisted development.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio links, App Store references, or GitHub links are welcome where available.
