jobs.excerpt: About UsSince 1989, SHI International Corp.  has helped organizations change the world through technology.
jobs.description:
About Us

Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services.

Over 17,000 organizations worldwide rely on SHI’s concierge approach to help them solve what’s next. But the heartbeat of SHI is our employees – all 7,000 of them. If you join our team, you’ll enjoy:

  • Our commitment to diversity, as the largest minority- and woman-owned enterprise in the U.S.

  • Continuous professional growth and leadership opportunities.

  • Health, wellness, and financial benefits to offer peace of mind to you and your family.

  • World-class facilities and the technology you need to thrive – in our offices or yours.

Job Summary

You'll be the security specialist for our Commercial sales teams, helping Account Executives win and grow mid-market accounts. Commercial reps manage a high volume of accounts and fast sales cycles. You'll provide practical cybersecurity expertise across areas such as Endpoint Security, SIEM/SOC, Email Security, Cloud Security, and Identity & Access Management, helping qualify opportunities, scope solutions, and accelerate deal closure. You'll engage Architects and Subject Matter Experts when deeper technical design or consultation is required.

This position is a remote position with Home Office setup as determined by SHI management.

Role Description

  • Support Commercial Account Executives across a high volume of security opportunities. Respond quickly with clear, practical, and customer-focused recommendations.
  • Join customer calls to identify security challenges, assess risks, and uncover modernization or refresh opportunities. Position solutions based on business value, risk reduction, operational efficiency, and compliance needs.
  • Help build pipeline by conducting account reviews, identifying expansion opportunities, and driving security assessments, renewals, and technology refresh initiatives.
  • Develop solution recommendations, quotes, and configurations that align with customer requirements, budgets, and security objectives.
  • Lead repeatable security plays across Endpoint Security, SIEM/SOC, Email Security, Cloud Security, Identity & Access Management, and related cybersecurity initiatives. Collaborate with adjacent practices such as Networking, Cloud, Data Center, and Services to deliver comprehensive solutions.
  • Leverage vendor programs, promotions, partner incentives, and deal registration opportunities to improve win rates and profitability.
  • Escalate larger or more complex opportunities to Security Architects and Engineering teams, ensuring a smooth handoff with complete technical and business requirements.
  • Coach Account Executives through one-on-one sessions, team meetings, and enablement activities focused on security fundamentals, competitive positioning, and customer conversations.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline and opportunity data within CRM systems and report progress against sales goals and key performance metrics.
  • Represent SHI at customer, partner, industry, and virtual events to promote cybersecurity solutions and thought leadership.

Behaviors and Competencies

  • Organization: Can prioritize daily tasks, manage personal workflow, and utilize basic tools to keep track of responsibilities.
  • Time Management: Can generally use time effectively but may occasionally struggle with prioritizing tasks, meeting deadlines, or maintaining work-life balance.
  • Initiative: Can identify opportunities for improvement, propose solutions, and take action without explicit instructions.
  • Communication: Can effectively communicate complex ideas and information, and can adapt communication style to the audience.
  • Digital Acumen: Can identify opportunities to use digital tools for improvement and propose digital solutions.
  • Consultative Sales: Can identify customer needs, propose suitable products or services, and take action to close sales without explicit instructions.
  • Continuous Improvement: Can identify moderate areas for improvement and implement moderate changes.
  • Relationship Building: Can identify opportunities for collaboration, propose strategies for effective communication, and build relationships without explicit instructions.
  • Teamwork: Can work effectively in a team, contributing ideas and effort, and respecting the contributions of others.
  • Presenting: Can prepare and deliver presentations, addressing key points and responding to questions with clarity.
  • Documentation: Can independently create and update documentation, ensuring accuracy and consistency, and can identify gaps or areas needing clarification.

Skill Level Requirements

  • The ability to effectively utilize applications like Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook to enhance productivity and perform various tasks efficiently - Basic
  • Proficiency in utilizing Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software to manage and analyze customer interactions and data throughout the customer lifecycle, improving customer service, retention, and sales growth - Basic
  • Proficiency in utilizing Cisco's suite of tools such as CCW, Connect the Dots, EOL/EOS Newsletters, Webex Teams, Datasheets, Installation Guides, and Customer Service Hub to support technical and sales-related tasks - Basic
  • Ability to understand and articulate various security technologies, including firewalls, endpoint protection, email security, and identity management, to identify and address customer security challenges - Basic
  • Skilled in providing guidance and mentorship to teams to enhance their performance and support their professional development - Basic

Other Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience supporting cybersecurity solutions in a sales, presales, technical sales, consulting, or practitioner role.

Compensation is determined based on a variety of factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, and the specific location of the role. Actual pay may differ depending on these factors.

What’s in it for you?

The Atrium SPIRIT is a belief in the power ofService, Perseverance, Inclusion, Respect, Innovation, and Teamwork to create an environment where everyone thrives. We go above and beyond to deliver exceptional guest experiences, work together to overcome challenges, and are passionate about positively impacting those around us.

  • Career Growth & Learning – 40% of our management hires are internal promotions!
  • Invest in Your Future– 401(k) plan with company match.

  • Perks That Fit Your Life – Enjoy DailyPay, wellness programs, tuition reimbursement, and exclusive discounts on your favorite brands and services.
  • Purpose & Impact – Make a difference through Atrium’s community service and volunteer programs.

Job Description

We have a pipeline of AI and automation opportunities. Now we’re looking for someone who can help bring them to life.


This is a remote internship within approved U.S. locations. Candidates must be physically located in the United States while performing internship duties and must have valid authorization to work in the United States before beginning employment.


Work performed outside the United States is not supported for this position.


Your work will focus on improving business processes through solutions built within Atrium’s approved Microsoft and Claude environments. You’ll start with a prioritized project, understand the business need, build and test a solution, and document your work so others can use and maintain it.

This is a hands-on building role—not an assignment to spend a semester writing about what AI might do someday.

What you’ll do

  • Review existing process documentation and workflow recommendations, including those captured through Scribe.
  • Work with your supervisor to select and scope an initial automation or AI-enabled project.
  • Translate business needs into practical workflows, applications, or tools.
  • Build solutions using approved technologies such as Microsoft Power Automate, Microsoft Copilot, and Claude Code.
  • Explore connections between systems using APIs or other approved integration methods.
  • Test functionality, troubleshoot issues, and refine solutions based on stakeholder feedback.
  • Document your approach, configuration, testing, limitations, and maintenance needs.
  • Demonstrate progress and contribute to a final project presentation and handoff.

What you’ll bring

We’re looking for a current student with demonstrated technical ability and an interest in applying AI and automation to real business problems.


You should be able to show:

  • Hands-on building experience. You’ve completed an automation, application, integration, or AI-enabled project and can explain your contribution.
  • AI fluency. You use AI tools thoughtfully to build, troubleshoot, and improve solutions—not just generate answers.
  • Process thinking. You can break a workflow into steps and identify opportunities to simplify or automate it.
  • Technical problem-solving. You’re comfortable experimenting, diagnosing issues, and testing whether a solution works.
  • Clear communication. You can explain technical work to people who may not share your technical background.
  • Ownership and follow-through. You can manage a defined assignment, communicate blockers, and leave useful documentation behind.
  • Sound judgment. You’re willing to follow company requirements for data handling, system access, and approved tools.

You do not need prior corporate employment experience. Coursework, personal projects, hackathons, research, and student-organization projects can all demonstrate your abilities.


Helpful technical experience

Experience with some of the following would be valuable; you do not need to check every box:

  • Claude Code or comparable AI-assisted development tools.
  • Microsoft Power Automate and Microsoft Copilot.
  • Workflow automation platforms such as n8n or Make.
  • APIs and connecting applications or services.
  • Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  • Data tools such as SQL or Snowflake.

Strong experience with n8n, Make, or another automation platform can be relevant even if you have not yet worked extensively in Power Automate.

Hospitality experience is welcome but not required. We’re interested in how you think, what you can build, and the perspective you bring.


What success looks like

At the beginning of the internship, you and your supervisor will agree on a project scope, milestones, and expected deliverables.

Depending on the project’s complexity, your final work may include:

  • A clearly defined business problem and proposed solution.
  • A documented proof of concept.
  • A working prototype or pilot.
  • Testing results and an explanation of limitations.
  • A demonstration for relevant stakeholders.
  • Documentation and a handoff that allows the team to continue the work.

The goal is useful, well-tested progress—not a long list of unfinished experiments.


What you’ll gain

  • Experience applying AI and automation to real business workflows.
  • Collaboration with technology and business stakeholders.
  • Practice moving from a business problem to a tested solution.
  • Feedback on your technical work, communication, and documentation.
  • A structured internship with clear expectations and review points.

Academic-credit requirements can be discussed during the selection process.


What to share when applying

Please submit:

  • Your résumé.
  • A brief description of one or two projects you’ve completed.
  • A link, screenshot, short demonstration, or other examples of your work, if available.
  • Your availability including potential start date and typical weekly hours.

For each project, tell us:

  • What problem were you trying to solve?
  • What tools did you use?
  • What did you personally build?
  • How did you test it?
  • What worked, and what would you improve?

A full portfolio is not required. One well-explained project is more valuable than a long list of tools.


Please share only material you are authorized to disclose. Do not include confidential information, credentials, or proprietary code from another organization.


Selection process

Selected candidates will participate in a panel conversation led by the internship supervisor and relevant team members. Be prepared to walk through a completed project, explain your decisions, and discuss how you approach unfamiliar problems.

Atrium is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected Veteran status.

jobs.description:
Role Description

Security Engineers at Dropbox safeguard our digital ecosystem alongside a diverse team of professionals dedicated to protecting our products and users. Trusted by millions, our mission is to integrate security seamlessly into Dropbox, empowering confident collaboration.

In this role, you’ll build and operate the identity and access controls that help Dropbox employees, services, and AI agents access what they need securely. You’ll combine security engineering and automation to strengthen authentication and authorization, enforce least privilege, and simplify identity lifecycle management across our infrastructure. Working closely with Infrastructure, Corp Engineering, Developer Platform, and Incident Response, you’ll make secure access easier to use and maintain reliable IAM services as Dropbox adopts new AI tools and agentic workflows.

Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes what’s expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here.

Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy, and operate IAM controls across Dropbox’s cloud and on-premises infrastructure
  • Design and implement secure identity, authentication, and authorization controls for AI agents and other non-human actors
  • Implement least-privilege access using RBAC, ABAC, permission boundaries, service control policies, and just-in-time access
  • Design secure integrations using SAML, OAuth 2.1, OpenID Connect, SCIM, and SPIFFE/SPIRE
  • Automate identity lifecycle processes to ensure access is granted, modified, and revoked promptly
  • Develop identity guardrails using infrastructure-as-code and policy-as-code
  • Build monitoring and alerting for anomalous authentication, privilege escalation, credential misuse, and unauthorized access
  • Partner with Incident Response to investigate identity-related incidents and rapidly revoke compromised access
  • Conduct security reviews and threat modeling for new identity architectures and integrations
  • Maintain IAM services with strong reliability, documentation, operational ownership, and on-call support

Many teams at Dropbox run Services with on-call rotations, which entails being available for calls during both core and non-core business hours. If a team has an on-call rotation, all engineers on the team are expected to participate in the rotation as part of their employment. Applicants are encouraged to ask for more details of the rotations to which the applicant is applying.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of security engineering experience, including substantial IAM or identity-security experience
  • Hands-on experience with Okta, Okta for AI Agents and Sailpoint, or comparable technologies
  • Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, least privilege, zero trust, and identity lifecycle management
  • Experience with SAML, OAuth 2.0/2.1, OpenID Connect, SCIM, and MFA
  • Experience designing RBAC or ABAC authorization models
  • Experience securing human and non-human identities, including services, workloads, automation, and CI/CD systems
  • Experience with agentic frameworks and MCP tool integration
  • Experience implementing access reviews, privileged-access controls, and joiner/mover/leaver workflows
  • Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language, such as Python, Go, Java, Ruby, or Bash
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code, policy-as-code, APIs, and security automation
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with workload identity technologies such as SPIFFE/SPIRE, Kubernetes service accounts, or cloud workload identity.
  • Experience securing identities and authorization for AI agents and other autonomous systems.
  • Experience with just-in-time access, zero-standing-privilege, or privileged-access management platforms.
  • Familiarity with identity threat detection and response.
  • Experience building IAM controls for multi-account cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with NIST SP 800-63, NIST SP 800-207, CIS benchmarks, and relevant identity-security guidance.
  • Experience supporting compliance programs such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or FedRAMP.
  • Security certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, or equivalent.
  • Contributions to the identity or security community through open-source projects, publications, or conferences.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technologycontinue to evolve:

  • Awareness:Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment:Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability:Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection:Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog postfrom our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

The Lead, Software Development AI Practice will also serve as the subject matter expert, and serve on the overall AI Governance Board, on AI platforms, generative AI, and agentic workflows/tools. This role builds our AI practice through hands-on coaching, demonstrations, proof-of-concept AI initiatives, and scalable enablement. Is this you? Find out more below!

  • Other duties as assigned.

Matter Health is seeking a hands-on, mission-driven AI Automation Workflow Specialist to join our Information Technology team. This individual contributor role is responsible for building and deploying AI-assisted workflow automations that support our operations, clinical, care support, and field-based teams—helping them spend less time on repetitive tasks and more time on the patients and work that matter most.
Working directly with business and clinical stakeholders, you will identify day-to-day workflow opportunities, configure and deploy automations using Matter Health's established AI tools and platform, and support adoption across the organization. This is a building and operational role—not a platform architecture or people management position.
This role is ideal for someone who learns new AI tools quickly, enjoys partnering with non-technical teams to solve real problems, and is excited about applying emerging AI capabilities in service of a genuine mission. This position reports to the Chief Technology Officer. This is a fully remote role with up to 10% travel for occasional in-person meetings or team offsites.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with clinical, care support, operations, and field-based teams to understand day-to-day workflows, pain points, and opportunities for AI-driven automation

  • Gather requirements from stakeholders with varying levels of technical fluency and translate real operational problems into automation ideas that can be built and tested quickly

  • Collect structured and informal feedback from clinicians, care support agents, operations staff, and field-based teams to guide ongoing iteration of deployed automations

  • Test and refine deployed automations with real users, iterating based on usage feedback and observed performance

  • Follow established platform standards, prompt and context templates, and controls when building and deploying automations—including those handling protected health information (PHI)

  • Create documentation, training materials, and enablement content to support successful adoption of new AI-driven workflows

  • Maintain a library of deployed automations, prompts, and workflow configurations to support consistency, reuse, and knowledge sharing across the organization

  • Support change management and adoption efforts as new automations are rolled out across operational teams

  • Partner with the AI Platform Engineer and stakeholders to evaluate when a deployed automation is ready to expand, refine, or retire

Qualifications

Required

  • Associate's or Bachelor's degree, or equivalent practical experience

  • 1–3 years of experience in business operations, process improvement, workflow automation, or a related operational role

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools, chatbots, or no-code/low-code automation platforms to build or configure workflows

  • Strong ability to gather requirements from business and clinical stakeholders with varying levels of technical fluency

  • Comfortable working within established technical standards, prompt and context templates, and controls without needing to design underlying platform architecture

  • Experience documenting workflows and automation configurations clearly for both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Basic understanding of responsible AI practices and safe handling of sensitive data, including protected health information (PHI)

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain new tools clearly to non-technical audiences

Preferred

  • Experience with EMR systems, healthcare data, or clinical workflow tools

  • Familiarity with value-based care, Medicare, or Medicare Advantage environments

  • Experience supporting distributed, remote, or field-based teams

  • Background in change management, user training, or internal enablement

  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, high-growth organization where priorities evolve

What Success Looks Like

  • Meaningful hours saved for operational, clinical, and field-based teams through deployed automations

  • Strong adoption of deployed automations by their target teams and users

  • A growing library of automations successfully built, deployed, and actively maintained in production

  • Efficient intake-to-launch cycle time from approved automation request to deployment

  • Collaborative, trusted relationships with clinical and operational stakeholders across the organization

  • Clear and accessible documentation that enables teams to understand and build on deployed workflows

  • Active contribution to a growing culture of AI-native thinking across the organization

Why Matter Health
At Matter Health, we believe that where you live should never determine the quality of care you receive. Every team member is vital in improving healthcare access for older adults who have historically been underserved by traditional healthcare systems.

We Lead with Love in Everything We Do.

jobs.description:
About Avaya

Job Description

Eligibility Requirement: US Citizenship Required

Reduce Risk. Accelerate Remediation. Strengthen Infrastructure Security.

Are you passionate about cybersecurity, vulnerability management, and reducing technology risk across complex cloud environments? Do you enjoy analyzing security vulnerabilities, partnering with technical teams, and driving remediation efforts that strengthen the security and resilience of critical systems?

We’re looking for two Infrastructure Security Vulnerability Engineers to help identify, prioritize, track, and remediate vulnerabilities across infrastructure and applications within a cloud-based FedRAMP Moderate-compliant environment supporting US federal government requirements.

This role will focus on accelerating vulnerability remediation in alignment with applicable Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) Binding Operational Directive (BOD) 26-04 requirements, leveraging threat intelligence, exposure data, and cloud-based AI tools to help application and infrastructure teams address security risks efficiently and effectively.

The ideal candidates bring hands-on vulnerability management experience, strong technical troubleshooting skills, and the ability to collaborate with application owners, infrastructure teams, vendors, and risk partners to drive vulnerabilities through resolution.

The Opportunity

As an Infrastructure Security Vulnerability Engineer, you’ll play a critical role in reducing the organization’s technology risk by managing vulnerability remediation activities from identification through closure. You’ll analyze findings from vulnerability assessment tools, evaluate risk and exposure, coordinate remediation plans, and track progress through established systems of record.

You’ll work closely with application managers, infrastructure teams, vendor managers, and risk partners to ensure vulnerabilities are prioritized appropriately and remediated within required time frames. You’ll also use cloud-based AI tools and established security practices to support vulnerability identification, improve remediation workflows, and contribute to reporting and continuous process improvement.

This role is ideal for a security professional who combines technical vulnerability analysis with strong coordination, communication, and reporting skills in a regulated cloud environment.

Your Mission-Critical Responsibilities

Vulnerability Management & Remediation: Lead and coordinate vulnerability remediation activities across infrastructure and applications, ensuring identified vulnerabilities are tracked, prioritized, and resolved in accordance with established security requirements and remediation timelines.

Exposure-Based Risk Prioritization: Evaluate vulnerabilities using CVE and CVSS data, exploitability, threat intelligence, asset criticality, attack paths, exposure information, and other relevant risk indicators to help determine remediation priorities.

CISA Directive Alignment: Support vulnerability remediation activities aligned with applicable CISA BOD 26-04 requirements and other relevant federal cybersecurity directives, including monitoring remediation progress against required deadlines.

Infrastructure & Application Security: Support vulnerability assessment and remediation across Windows Server 2019 and above, Linux/RHEL 9.x and above, and application environments. Work with technical teams to identify appropriate remediation approaches, including patching, configuration changes, and other corrective actions.

Vulnerability Assessment Tools: Use tools such as Tenable Security Center, Nessus, and Qualys to review vulnerability findings, validate remediation status, identify outstanding exposures, and support ongoing vulnerability management operations.

Application & Infrastructure Team Collaboration: Partner with application owners, application managers, infrastructure teams, vendor managers, and risk partners to communicate findings, clarify remediation requirements, resolve technical or process-related questions, and drive issues to closure.

Tracking & System of Record Management: Maintain accurate vulnerability records in ServiceNow or other designated systems of record. Update remediation status, document actions taken, track outstanding items, and ensure records reflect the current state of identified vulnerabilities.

Patch Management & Change Coordination: Coordinate patching and remediation activities with application and infrastructure teams, following established change management processes and supporting timely, controlled implementation of corrective actions.

Exception Management & Risk Response: Support vulnerability exception management, risk-based remediation decisions, incident-driven response activities, and escalation of overdue or unresolved vulnerabilities to the appropriate stakeholders.

AI-Assisted Vulnerability Analysis: Leverage cloud-based AI tools, where appropriate, to support vulnerability identification, analysis, prioritization, and remediation workflows while applying sound security judgment and established review processes.

Risk Metrics & Reporting: Develop and maintain periodic vulnerability management metrics and reports, including remediation progress, aging vulnerabilities, overdue findings, risk trends, and other indicators used to communicate exposure and remediation effectiveness.

Process Improvement & Documentation: Identify opportunities to improve vulnerability management procedures, remediation workflows, reporting accuracy, and operational efficiency. Maintain clear documentation of findings, remediation activities, exceptions, and supporting processes.

What You Bring to the Team

The Vulnerability Management Experience: 3–5+ years of experience in vulnerability management, vulnerability remediation, patch management, or a closely related infrastructure security role.

The Security Assessment Toolkit: Hands-on experience with vulnerability assessment and management tools, including Tenable Security Center, Nessus, and Qualys.

The Windows Foundation: Working knowledge of Windows Server 2019 and later, including vulnerability remediation, security patching, and system configuration.

The Linux Foundation: Experience supporting Linux environments, particularly Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) 9.x and later, including security updates, patching, and vulnerability remediation.

The Risk-Based Approach: Understanding of CVE and CVSS analysis, vulnerability prioritization, exploitability, threat intelligence, asset criticality, and exposure-based remediation practices.

The Remediation Mindset: Demonstrated experience coordinating vulnerability remediation and patch management activities, tracking findings through closure, and working with technical teams to resolve outstanding security issues.

The Change Management Discipline: Familiarity with change management processes and the ability to coordinate remediation activities while supporting operational stability and established controls.

The Service Management Skills: Experience using ServiceNow ticketing or similar systems to track vulnerabilities, document remediation progress, manage escalations, and maintain accurate records.

The Reporting & Analytics Capability: Strong Microsoft Excel and reporting skills, with the ability to analyze vulnerability data, track remediation metrics, identify trends, and communicate risk status clearly.

The Collaboration Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with application owners, infrastructure teams, vendors, and risk stakeholders to drive remediation outcomes.

The Problem Solver: Strong analytical, organizational, and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to investigate technical findings, clarify remediation requirements, and manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment.

The Federal Security Awareness: Ability to work within a regulated cloud environment and follow established security, compliance, documentation, and risk management processes.

The Citizenship Requirement: Must be a US citizen.

Extra Credit (The Nice-to-Haves)

  • Federal Cybersecurity Frameworks: Familiarity with FedRAMP, NIST SP 800-53, DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs), and federal cybersecurity compliance requirements.
  • Threat Intelligence & Exploitation Awareness: Experience using CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) information and other threat intelligence sources to prioritize remediation based on active exploitation and emerging threats.
  • Federal & DoD Environments: Experience supporting US federal government, Department of Defense (DoD), or other regulated enterprise environments.
  • Automation & Scripting: Experience using PowerShell, Bash, or Python to automate vulnerability analysis, reporting, patch management, or remediation workflows.
  • Endpoint Management: Familiarity with ManageEngine Endpoint Central or similar endpoint management and patch deployment platforms.
  • Virtualization & Directory Services: Experience supporting VMware environments and Active Directory infrastructure.
  • Application Security Remediation: Experience identifying and coordinating remediation of application vulnerabilities, including web application security findings.
  • Cloud Security & AI Tools: Familiarity with cloud security technologies and AI-assisted tools used for vulnerability analysis, security operations, and risk reduction.
  • Continuous Improvement: A track record of improving vulnerability remediation timelines, strengthening reporting processes, and reducing technology risk through effective coordination and automation.

Preferred Certifications

Relevant cybersecurity, vulnerability management, infrastructure security, or cloud security certifications are desirable.

Examples include CompTIA Security+, CompTIA CySA+, Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), and other relevant security certifications.

Why Join Us?

Meaningful Cybersecurity Impact: Help reduce technology risk and strengthen the security posture of cloud environments supporting critical federal government operations.

Mission-Critical Security Work: Contribute to vulnerability remediation activities aligned with federal cybersecurity directives and established compliance requirements.

Technical Problem-Solving: Work across infrastructure, applications, vulnerability assessment tools, and remediation processes to address complex security challenges.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with application owners, infrastructure engineers, vendors, and risk stakeholders to deliver measurable improvements in security and operational effectiveness.

Continuous Improvement: Help optimize vulnerability management practices, improve remediation efficiency, and strengthen risk reporting through automation, analytics, and emerging AI-assisted capabilities.

jobs.description:
We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Systems Reliability Engineer to ensure the availability, performance, scalability, and reliability of our organization's IT systems and infrastructure. The successful candidate will work closely with software engineering, IT operations, cloud infrastructure, and security teams to prevent system failures, automate operational processes, and improve overall service reliability.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in systems administration, cloud infrastructure, monitoring, incident management, and automation. This role is suited to a professional who can identify potential system issues before they affect users and implement effective solutions to maintain stable, secure, and efficient operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain reliable, scalable, and highly available systems and infrastructure.
  • Monitor system health, availability, resource utilization, and application performance using observability tools.
  • Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve complex system failures, performance bottlenecks, and infrastructure issues.
  • Conduct root cause analysis and implement preventive measures to minimize recurring incidents.
  • Automate routine system administration and operational tasks using Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar scripting languages.
  • Manage and optimize Linux and Windows server environments.
  • Support cloud infrastructure across platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform.
  • Implement system redundancy, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery strategies.
  • Develop and maintain monitoring dashboards, alerting systems, and incident response procedures.
  • Establish and track service-level indicators (SLIs), service-level objectives (SLOs), and service-level agreements (SLAs).
  • Collaborate with development teams to improve system performance, deployment reliability, and operational readiness.
  • Manage infrastructure configuration, patching, upgrades, and capacity planning.
  • Support containerized environments and orchestration platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Maintain technical documentation, system architecture diagrams, and standard operating procedures.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and incident response activities when required.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Systems Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Three or more years of experience in systems engineering, systems administration, site reliability engineering, or infrastructure operations.
  • Strong knowledge of Linux and/or Windows server administration.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar tools.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or New Relic.
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals, storage systems, databases, and distributed systems.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, version control, and infrastructure automation.
  • Experience with incident management, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis.
  • Strong analytical, communication, documentation, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with site reliability engineering (SRE) principles and reliability-focused engineering practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized workloads.
  • Relevant certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Azure Administrator, Google Cloud certifications, or Red Hat certifications.
  • Familiarity with security best practices, access management, vulnerability remediation, and compliance requirements.
  • Experience managing production systems in enterprise, cloud-native, or high-availability environments.

Compensation and Benefits

The anticipated salary range for this position is $110,000–$160,000 per year for a full-time position in the United States. Candidates with advanced expertise in cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, automation, Kubernetes, and large-scale production reliability may qualify for compensation toward the upper end of the range.

Actual compensation will depend on experience, technical qualifications, geographic location, job complexity, and the employer's compensation structure.

Depending on the employer, the benefits package may include:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave.
  • Retirement savings plans with employer matching, where available.
  • Professional development and certification reimbursement.
  • Remote or hybrid work flexibility, where applicable.
  • Performance-based bonuses or other incentives, where offered.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance may be measured using the following indicators:

  • System uptime and service availability.
  • Mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to recover (MTTR).
  • Reduction in recurring incidents and unplanned downtime.
  • System response times and resource utilization.
  • Effectiveness of automation and operational improvements.
  • Compliance with backup, recovery, security, and maintenance requirements.
  • Achievement of established SLOs and reliability targets.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a proactive and technically skilled professional who understands how to maintain dependable systems in complex environments. They should be comfortable troubleshooting critical issues, automating repetitive tasks, analyzing system performance, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to continuously improve reliability and operational efficiency.

Equal Opportunity Statement

jobs.description:
Who are we and why should you join us?

BetterHelp is on a mission to remove the traditional barriers to therapy and make mental health care more accessible to everyone. Founded in 2013, we are now the world’s largest online therapy service, providing affordable and convenient therapy across the globe. Our network of over 30,000 licensed therapists has helped millions of people take ownership of their mental health and change their lives forever. And we’re not stopping there – as the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution.

As a Senior Analytics Engineer at BetterHelp, you’ll join a diverse team of licensed clinicians, engineers, product pros, creatives, marketers, and business leaders who share a passion for expanding access to therapy. And as a mental health company, we take employee mental health just as seriously as we do our mission. We deeply invest in our team’s well-being and professional development, because we know that business and individual growth go hand-in-hand. At BetterHelp, you’ll carve your own path, make an immediate impact, and be challenged every day – with a supportive community behind you the whole way.

What are we looking for?

We are looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to help us build best-in-class data products that deliver high-quality, trustworthy data and keep pace with our accelerated growth. These products must be built and maintained using best practices so they stay scalable and earn stakeholder trust as we grow in both size and scope. This person will work cross-functionally with technical and business stakeholders across the company, and will optimize our data stack to deliver trustworthy, discoverable, impactful data, served to both people and the AI tools they increasingly rely on.

What will you do?

  • Employ your strong SQL and data modeling skills to propose, design, and build trusted tables in our data warehouse via dbt, serving as a single source of truth for business intelligence, data science, and machine learning use cases.
  • Lead end-to-end dimensional modeling efforts, from requirements gathering through implementation, testing, and delivery, creating high-quality data experiences and collaborating directly with stakeholders to support their analytical success.
  • Design and extend our semantic layer: the governed, metric-driven interface (built as Snowflake semantic views in dbt) that powers Looker and our natural-language BI chatbot, so stakeholders and AI agents get the same trusted answer to the same question. This includes defining canonical metrics, relationships, and verified queries grounded in real business questions.
  • Use your experience with business partners and your empathy for users to translate stakeholder needs into well-structured data models and downstream experiences in Looker.
  • Act as a subject matter expert (SME) for cross-functional teams, enabling data-driven decision-making through dashboards, self-serve tooling, and ad-hoc analyses, especially for data-forward teams like marketing, international growth, and insurance.
  • Uphold data governance and privacy in a healthcare environment, applying PII/PHI classification, masking policies, and data contracts so our data assets stay trustworthy and protected as they scale.
  • Build for performance and cost at "big data" scale, using incrementality patterns, sound warehouse and clustering choices, and query optimization so our models stay fast and efficient as volume grows.
  • Contribute to BetterHelp's data-driven culture by supporting self-service, improving data discovery and lineage, and fostering trust in our data assets.
  • Partner closely with data and machine learning engineers in our modern data stack, which includes dbt, Looker, Snowflake, Airflow, Snowplow, and Fivetran.
  • Enjoy great teamwork, collaborate with data-minded colleagues who care deeply about mental health, and take pride in building a world-class product that makes a difference in people's lives.

What will you NOT do?

  • You will NOT worry about "runway", "cash left", or "how much time we have until the next round". We have the startup DNA but we're fully backed and funded, all the way to success.
  • You will NOT be confined to your "job". You will get involved in product, marketing, business strategy, and almost everything we do.
  • You will NOT be bogged down by office politics, ego, or bad attitude. Only positive, pleasure-to-work-with people are allowed here!
  • You will NOT get yourself burned out. We work hard but we believe in maintaining a sustainable work/life balance. Really.

Can I work remotely?

Yes. We operate on PST and candidates in any time zone are welcome to apply. We ask employees to travel to our San Jose, CA office up to three times per year plus one company-wide offsite to collaborate in person and strengthen working relationships. Travel expenses are covered and reasonable accommodations are made for those under unique circumstances who cannot travel.

Requirements

  • At least 5 years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, data analytics, or a related field
  • At least 4 years of experience working with business intelligence (BI) tools, preferably Looker or Omni
  • At least 3 years of experience using dbt for in-warehouse data transformations
  • Strong technical abilities in SQL, including "big data" scale query design, incrementality patterns, and performance optimization
  • Deep understanding of frameworks and tradeoffs in building analytical data models (for example star schemas, analytics-ready design patterns, and dimensional modeling)
  • Excellent communication skills, strong attention to detail, and effective time management
  • Experience providing mentorship, supporting collaborative development, and conducting team pull request (PR) reviews
  • Strong knowledge of data testing, including assertion design, coverage, orchestration, and data contracts
  • Experience with version control using Git in a collaborative team environment
  • Authorized to work in the U.S.

Bonus (Great to have, but not required)

  • BS/MA in a quantitative discipline such as Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or Engineering
  • Significant experience with dimensional modeling, including building fact and dimension tables at "big data" scale using Kimball-style or denormalized design patterns
  • Experience building or maintaining a semantic or metrics layer (for example Snowflake semantic views, the dbt Semantic Layer, or LookML as a semantic layer), or otherwise designing data for AI and natural-language analytics
  • Familiarity with data privacy and governance in a regulated or healthcare setting
  • Hands-on experience with data pipelines and analytics using a scripting language, preferably Python
  • Background working with web-based B2C products, especially in healthcare or marketing analytics
  • Experience serving as an agile or technical lead within a data-driven organization
  • Strong familiarity with stream event analytics and web event tracking tools (for example Snowplow, Mixpanel, or Amplitude)

Benefits

  • Remote work with regular in-person bonding experiences sponsored by the company
  • Competitive compensation
  • Holistic perks program (including free therapy, employee wellness, and more)
  • Excellent health, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401k benefits with employer matching contribution
  • The chance to build something that changes lives – and that people love

jobs.description:
Company Overview:

PartsBase Inc. is the world's largest online Aviation Marketplace and Community. Our global community is comprised of over 6,500 companies accessing our technology in over 140+ countries & territories. We work with some of the biggest brands in aviation including Delta, Northrop Gruman, AvAir, Heico, Chevron, Air France Industries, and Air Australia.

PartsBase offers a FULLY remote environment where one can work at the forefront of where the aviation business meets technology. Imagine getting to work with peers worldwide, implementing business technology projects that challenge the boundaries.

Life at PartsBase:

One of the top benefits of working at PartsBase is the culture. We are a TEAM-focused organization, and everyone celebrates each other's successes. Our inclusive culture welcomes all employees and values their unique contributions to our success. Our clients tell us time and time again that our people set us apart from the competition. We naturally strive to hire the very best talent. The ideal candidate is a motivated, well-organized individual who has a deep understanding of prospecting and developing strong relationships with customers.

About the Role

GTM Engineering sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, revenue generation, data, and automation, turning market intelligence and buyer insight into repeatable growth opportunities for PartsBase.

PartsBase is seeking a GTM Engineer to build and scale the workflows, systems, and outbound strategies that help our Sales teams engage the right aviation, aerospace, and defense buyers and suppliers at the right time. This is not a traditional demand generation or marketing operations role. GTM Engineers are hands-on builders who own the full lifecycle of a growth play, from identifying an opportunity and developing a hypothesis through workflow creation, experimentation, and measurable commercial impact.

The role combines growth marketing, account-based strategy, data enrichment, AI, and sales enablement. You will work directly with Sales to identify promising markets, uncover buying signals, map buying committees, and turn these insights into targeted outbound plays. Using Clay, AI, and connected data workflows, you will give sellers the context and tools they need to engage prospects more effectively and to convert them into active marketplace subscribers.

Success requires strong marketing judgment, technical curiosity, hands-on workflow-building experience, and the ability to connect automation to real commercial outcomes.

In This Role, You'll

  • Identify promising market segments, buying situations, and account-level triggers in partnership with Sales, such as fleet changes, new repair station certifications, AOG demand, and distributor expansion.

  • Develop targeted outbound plays, defining the audience, buyer problem, messaging, offer, seller action, and success criteria.

  • Build, own, and optimize Clay tables and research workflows, connecting enrichment, signal detection, account research, and contact discovery.

  • Use AI to interpret market signals, classify accounts, and generate relevant research and messaging inputs.

  • Map key accounts and buying committees across airlines, MROs, distributors, OEMs, and government and defense buyers, providing sellers with clear, evidence-based insights and recommended actions.

  • Work directly with Sales teams to test outbound plays, gather feedback, measure performance, and determine what to scale or refine.

  • Establish quality controls and source references to ensure research and AI-generated outputs are accurate and trustworthy.

  • Turn successful experiments into reusable workflows, signals, audience logic, and play templates.

  • Connect outbound strategies with ABM, paid media, and lifecycle marketing initiatives, including new subscriber acquisition, onboarding, engagement, and renewal.

  • Partner with RevOps on CRM integrations, sales tooling, tracking, and workflow governance.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience building B2B outbound, growth marketing, demand generation, or account-based marketing programs.

  • Strong marketing judgment across segmentation, buyer problems, positioning, and messaging.

  • Hands-on experience with Clay or similar data enrichment and workflow automation platforms.

  • Practical experience using AI for research, classification, personalization, and decision support.

  • A track record of working directly with Sales teams to turn growth ideas into executed outbound plays.

  • Experience identifying buying signals, researching accounts, and mapping buying committees.

  • The ability to distinguish verified evidence from assumptions and evaluate results critically.

  • A commercially minded approach, connecting growth activity to meetings, opportunities, and pipeline.

Required Skills

Growth Marketing and GTM Strategy

  • Understanding of B2B go-to-market strategies, outbound motions, demand generation, and ABM.

  • Ability to identify high-value segments and translate buyer insight into targeted growth plays.

  • Experience developing messaging and value propositions for specific audiences.

  • Attribution & Tracking: Strong grasp of UTM governance, campaign tracking, attribution modeling, and funnel analytics.

Technical and Automation Skills

  • Hands-on experience with Clay or comparable enrichment and automation platforms.

  • AI & Agentic Workflows: Hands-on experience building and running AI-powered workflows or agents in production, using tools like Claude, OpenAI, Clay, n8n, or HubSpot's AI features. You know where AI adds real leverage and where it adds noise.

  • HubSpot: Hands-on expertise, including workflows, scoring, lifecycle management, and building custom objects and data models.

  • Systems Architecture: A track record of designing and maintaining marketing and GTM systems, including website, CRM, and campaign infrastructure, and how they connect.

  • Integrations: Experience managing APIs, middleware tools, and data syncs across GTM systems, connecting data sources, research workflows, and automation tools.

  • Ability to structure data, troubleshoot workflows, and maintain data quality.

Sales Partnership and Execution

  • Proven ability to work closely with Sales teams to develop and execute outbound strategies.

  • Ability to translate account insights into clear seller context and actionable recommendations.

  • Experience gathering feedback, improving adoption, and measuring commercial impact.

Day-to-Day Activities

  • Identify growth opportunities through market research, buyer signals, and Sales feedback.

  • Build and maintain Clay tables for account enrichment, contact discovery, research, and prioritization.

  • Develop AI-powered workflows that generate accurate account insights and seller context.

  • Create and launch targeted outbound plays with Sales teams.

  • Analyze performance across engagement, meetings, opportunities, and pipeline.

  • Refine, scale, or retire workflows based on results and seller feedback.

  • Develop reusable research components, signals, and play templates.

  • Work with RevOps on ORO, tracking, and governance.

  • Document workflows and best practices to support adoption across teams and markets.

Personal Attributes

  • Builder mentality: enjoys getting hands-on with tools, data, workflows, and automation.

  • Commercially minded, focused on generating meaningful sales conversations, opportunities, and pipeline.

  • Naturally curious about buyer behavior, aviation aftermarket dynamics, and emerging technologies.

  • Analytical and evidence-driven, with strong attention to research quality and accuracy.

  • Experimentation-focused, comfortable testing ideas and learning from results.

  • Collaborative and confident working directly with Sales and cross-functional teams.

  • Self-starter who takes ownership and thrives in a fast-paced environment.

  • Excited by the potential of AI, automation, and connected data to transform go-to-market strategies.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with ORO, Salesforce, Marketo, Demandbase, Goldcast, or Qualified.

  • Familiarity with sales engagement platforms and outbound sequencing tools.

  • Experience building dashboards and analysis in tools like Power BI, Looker, or Tableau.

  • Background in aviation, aerospace, defense, or B2B marketplace businesses (a plus, not a requirement).

AI at PartsBase

AI is not a feature at PartsBase; it is a new way of working. It turns instructions into work done and helps us move faster for the buyers and suppliers who depend on us to source critical aviation parts. We expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. PartsBase sits at a rare intersection of marketplace data, aviation industry relationships, and deep aftermarket expertise, and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of applying AI to it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment, but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

Equal Opportunity Employer

PartsBase is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants, and we make employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you need an accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know.

jobs.excerpt: The Company Versaterm is a PE-backed, high-growth SaaS company building a fully integrated platform across the entire public safety ecosystem — dispatch, law enforcement, forensics, courts, and beyond.
jobs.description:
The Company

Versaterm is a PE-backed, high-growth SaaS company building a fully integrated platform across the entire public safety ecosystem — dispatch, law enforcement, forensics, courts, and beyond. We've grown through strategic acquisitions and deep product investment. What connects all of it is a single purpose: give public safety agencies the tools and insights to make better decisions in high-stakes moments.

When a 911 call is answered, a detective investigates a case, or a forensic lab processes evidence, there's a good chance our software is working behind the scenes. That's been true for over four decades.

AI is central to where we're going. Not as a feature but as core infrastructure. We're embedding intelligence directly into the workflows our customers rely on every day, and we're doing it alongside them. Our customers tell us what the mission demands. We build what answers it.

This work attracts a specific kind of person — someone who wants to be pushed by great people, build things that outlast a sprint cycle, and go home knowing the work connected back to something real.

The Role

The AI Native Senior Software Engineer is a change agent and a driver of value within our public safety ecosystem. Public safety agencies, dispatchers, and first responders count on our software every day, so reliability and security come first. You will architect, own, and deliver innovation to customers and be accountable for the results it produces for our users and our business. You will work across the VersatermOS platform and our broader product portfolio, bringing deep technical and architecture knowledge together with AI native development practices to build solutions that are reliable, secure, scalable, and cost-efficient. You will also lead by example and help engineers on the team(s) adopt the same ways of working. You should be passionate about shaping the future of public safety and revel in the fact that no task is too small or too big to make a difference to the people we serve. You will own and shape product with your team, from idea through production, and set the direction and tone for generating value for our customers and business.

The Direction

This position will have the opportunity to contribute to several tech stacks across our public safety portfolio. Our direction is to build working solutions quickly using the full range of AI native tools and practices, including coding agents, spec-driven development, AI-assisted design and code review, automated test generation, and agent workflows built into our CI/CD pipelines. You will work closely with your team to do this without giving up the reliability, security, and quality our customers rely on. You will be a hands-on leader in this space, setting the example for how we use AI to deliver software and helping staff build the same skill set you have. The AI Native Senior Software Engineer should be passionate about agentic development, architecture, and driving innovation to help shape the future of our software products.

What You Do

  • Lead the design and architecture of complex, scalable software solutions, ensuring they are secure, highly available, fault tolerant, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
  • Take ownership of high-impact projects from understanding the user's problem through design, implementation, deployment, and support in production, and check that what you shipped delivered the value we expected.
  • Mentor and provide guidance to associate engineers, helping them grow in their careers and improve their coding practices, including how they work with AI tools. Provide constructive feedback and assistance.
  • Be a leader in how our teams use AI to deliver software. Try new tools and approaches, figure out what actually works for our products, and turn it into shared practices, agent configurations, and examples the rest of the team can pick up.
  • Work closely with product managers, designers, customers, and other teams to deliver software in small increments of business value, using customer feedback and data to decide what comes next.
  • Focus on optimizing application performance, ensuring that the software scales effectively under increased loads and performs reliably in production. Set service level objectives (SLOs) and put the monitoring and alerting in place to meet them.
  • Support what you build in production. This includes taking part in on-call, leading the response when critical issues come up, and following through on post-incident reviews so the same problem doesn't happen twice.
  • Lead efforts to resolve complex technical issues and make sure software meets business requirements. Catch defects before they reach customers through automated test suites that cover the depth and breadth of solutions, quality gates in the CI/CD pipeline, and safe release practices like feature flags, staged rollouts, and quick rollback.
  • Build security into your work from the beginning with secure coding practices, threat modeling, dependency scanning, and least-privilege access. Protect sensitive data such as Criminal Justice Information (CJI) and personally identifiable information (PII) in line with the CJIS Security Policy and our internal standards.
  • Review AI-generated code with the same care as code written by hand by utilizing modern methods and AI practices. You own every change you ship, and you will help set the review, testing, and data handling practices that let the team move quickly with AI while staying safe.
  • Stay up to date with the latest industry trends, tools, and technologies, especially in the fast-moving AI space. Drive innovation and suggest improvements to the development process, architecture, and product features.
  • Participate in daily collaboration with team members and retrospectives for work generated. Help the team break down complex tasks into quick achievable value increments.
  • Ensure that code, system designs, and technical processes are well-documented for knowledge sharing and future reference by people and AI agents.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned to support team objectives, departmental needs, and overall organizational priorities.

What You Bring

Required Qualifications:

  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience and training.
  • 6+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Advanced, hands-on experience delivering software with modern AI development tools and methods, including coding agents, spec-driven development, context engineering, and AI-assisted testing and code review, along with good judgment on how to verify what AI produces.
  • A genuine passion for AI native development and experience leading a team through the adoption of new tools and ways of working.

  • Deep understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and principles for delivering Software as a Service (SaaS). Experience in designing scalable and distributed systems.
  • Experience building and running production systems with high availability requirements, including monitoring, incident response, and root cause analysis.
  • Experience with DevOps and CI/CD practices, including continuous integration, continuous deployment, and tools like Kubernetes, ArgoCD, and Terraform.
  • Experience with automated testing, test-driven development (TDD), and testing frameworks.
  • Good understanding of secure development practices (for example OWASP Top 10, threat modeling, and secrets management) and experience applying security controls in software and DevOps processes.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and collaboration skills. Ability to work cross-functionally with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to pass required background and security screening, including the fingerprint-based check required under the FBI CJIS Security Policy.

Asset Qualifications:

  • Working knowledge of Microservices, SOA, Monolith, REST, RPC, SQL, NoSQL, etc.
  • Experience building and evaluating AI harnesses, MCP servers, knowledge graphs, multi-agent workflows, and other agentic tooling.

Entegrata helps law firms turn data into decision-grade insights. You'll be the technical counterpart to our Customer Experience Managers (CXM) on every customer implementation. While the CXM owns the project plan and customer relationship, you own the technical execution — making sure environments are configured correctly, data is mapped accurately, and the lakehouse is delivering reliable outputs before go-live.

This is a customer-facing role. You'll participate in kickoff sessions, lead technical working sessions with law firm IT teams, and lead when the conversation turns to data.

  • Environment setup — provisioning customer instances, configuring networking connections, and establishing data connections between Entegrata's platform and customer source systems

jobs.description:
Athena Developer & Integration Analyst

About Matter Health

Matter Health delivers primary and preventive healthcare directly to older adults living in public housing communities.

Our mission is simple: to improve healthcare access by meeting patients where they are and building trusted relationships within the communities we serve. We are rapidly expanding and are seeking mission-driven professionals who thrive in fast-paced, people-centered environments.

We Lead with Love in Everything We Do.

About the Role

Matter Health is seeking a hands-on, technically skilled Athena Developer & Integration Analyst to join our Information Technology team. This individual contributor role will own the development, extension, and integration of our EHR ecosystem, serving as the organization's go-to technical resource on the athenaOne API suite, custom endpoint development, and platform-level configuration.

Our value-based care model depends on a deeply extended, tightly integrated athenaOne platform to support our field-based clinical teams. You will build against athenahealth's 800+ endpoint API surface, architect integrations, and extend what athenaOne can do for our care teams—while also evaluating and introducing AI and agentic tooling that can reduce documentation burden and surface clinical insight for the people doing the work.

This is primarily a software engineering role: writing code against athenahealth's APIs, designing integrations, and extending platform capabilities. Platform administration and configuration are a critical but secondary function, providing senior-level expertise in support of existing administrative capability. This position reports to the Chief Technology Officer. This is a fully remote role with up to 10% travel for occasional in-person meetings or team offsites.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain custom integrations and extensions on the athenaOne platform using athenahealth's REST and FHIR APIs across Clinicals, Collector, Communicator, and Population Health endpoints

  • Own the full API development lifecycle for athenaOne integrations, including sandbox testing, OAuth 2.0 authentication and token management, endpoint evaluation, versioning, and production rollout

  • Evaluate and prototype AI and agentic tooling within the athenahealth ecosystem—including Marketplace AI-powered solutions and LLM-based workflow automation—to reduce documentation burden and surface clinical insight for field-based care teams

  • Monitor athenahealth API changelogs and release notes, evaluate new endpoints and capabilities as they are released, and manage regression testing and rollout of platform and integration updates

  • Work directly with athenahealth's developer support and partner teams to resolve API issues, request custom endpoints, and pilot new AI-enabled capabilities

  • Design, build, and maintain bidirectional integrations between athenaClinicals and Salesforce, including the middleware, webhooks, and custom API calls that keep both systems in sync

  • Manage authentication, data mapping, transformation logic, and error handling for inbound and outbound data flows—including referrals, care plans, visit data, care team updates, and SDOH data—using REST, HL7, and FHIR-based interfaces as appropriate

  • Partner with clinical leadership to translate workflow needs into athenaClinicals build and configuration, moving fluidly between configuration and code as needed

  • Provide senior-level backup on athenaOne administration, including user roles and provider setup, departments and permission structures, templates, order sets, and quality and HCC risk-capture workflows tailored to a DSNP, dual-eligible population

  • Maintain technical documentation of integration architecture, API usage, data mappings, system configuration, and change history for audit and compliance purposes

  • Troubleshoot API errors, data sync failures, and integration issues across the athenaOne platform and the Salesforce-athenaClinicals integration, serving as the primary internal point of contact for EHR functionality and technical integration questions

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Health Informatics, Information Systems, or a related field; equivalent experience considered

  • 3–5 years of experience working with athenahealth products, with the majority in hands-on API development against athenaOne/athenaClinicals REST and FHIR endpoints

  • Demonstrated, hands-on experience designing, building, and maintaining custom integrations using athenahealth's APIs, including OAuth-based authentication, webhook configuration, and endpoint-level troubleshooting

  • Proficiency with at least one modern programming or scripting language such as Python, JavaScript/Node.js, or Java for API development

  • Working knowledge of HL7 v2 and FHIR R4 data standards

  • Working familiarity with athenaClinicals configuration and administration, including user and provider setup, templates, and order sets

  • Understanding of HIPAA and healthcare data privacy and security requirements as they apply to system configuration and integrations

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate across technical, clinical, and operational teams

Preferred

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce or a comparable CRM or care-coordination platform integration

  • Experience with AI or agentic tooling in the athenahealth ecosystem, such as Marketplace AI-powered apps, ambient documentation tools, or LLM-based workflow automation

  • Familiarity with quality measures, HCC and risk adjustment documentation, and special needs plan (DSNP) reporting requirements

  • Experience in home-based care, geriatrics, or value-based care settings

  • Experience in a fast-growing, mission-driven healthcare organization

What Success Looks Like

  • athenaOne integrations are reliable, well-documented, and actively maintained in production with clear ownership

  • The Salesforce-athenaClinicals integration is stable, accurate, and supports seamless care coordination across clinical and operational teams

  • New athenahealth API capabilities and AI-enabled tools are evaluated proactively and piloted where they can meaningfully reduce burden on clinical teams

  • Clinical and operational stakeholders have a trusted, responsive internal resource for EHR functionality and integration questions

  • Integration architecture, API usage, and system configuration are thoroughly documented and audit-ready

  • Platform updates and API changes are managed with minimal disruption to clinical workflows

Why Matter Health

At Matter Health, we believe that where you live should never determine the quality of care you receive. Every team member is vital in improving healthcare access for older adults who have historically been underserved by traditional healthcare systems.

This isn't just a mission statement—it's the work we do every day.

We Lead with Love in Everything We Do.

Working at Matter Health

We're committed to supporting our team both professionally and personally. Benefits for full-time team members begin on the first of the month after your start date.

Health & Wellness

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • Employer-funded HSA options

  • Employer-paid life and disability insurance

  • Voluntary illness, accident, and hospitalization coverage

  • Access to Matter Health's in-person and virtual care services

Financial Security

  • 401(k) with company match starting on Day 60

  • Financial wellness resources and support

Time Away

  • 10 paid company holidays

Eligibility is based on full-time employment status. Additional details will be shared during the interview process.

Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!

Location: 100% Remote
