About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve our engineering workflows, and build practical knowledge across the team.

We are looking for a senior developer who can take ownership of mobile development, deliver reliable software, and help our team become more effective at building applications with AI.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Mobile App Developer with strong Kotlin Multiplatform expertise and an excellent background in native Android development with Kotlin.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will develop and improve our application, solve complex technical problems, and establish effective workflows for AI-assisted and agentic development. Experience with GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or related location and proximity technologies would be particularly valuable.

You will also share your knowledge with our internal team, including mentoring a junior team member who is learning to build Android applications through AI-assisted development, often referred to as “vibe coding.”

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and improve our Android application using Kotlin and Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Design shared application logic and integrate it with platform-specific functionality.
  • Implement and troubleshoot location and proximity features involving GPS, BLE, UWB, and related device capabilities.
  • Address practical mobile challenges such as permissions, background execution, battery consumption, connectivity, and differences between devices.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents extensively to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and support testing.
  • Set up and improve agentic development workflows, including task decomposition, project context, automated checks, and review processes.
  • Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
  • Test relevant functionality on real devices and resolve problems that automated tests alone may not reveal.
  • Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and understandable explanations.
  • Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production Android applications with Kotlin.
  • Strong practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform, including shared code, platform-specific integrations, and the boundaries between them.
  • Solid understanding of Android architecture, Jetpack Compose, coroutines, Flow, application lifecycle, and state management.
  • Strong debugging skills and the ability to investigate problems across application code, APIs, and device behavior.
  • Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
  • A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
  • The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain why an implementation is appropriate.
  • Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly.
  • The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • GPS positioning, location accuracy, sensor data, and proximity detection.
  • BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and signal-strength limitations.
  • UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility.
  • NFC and other device-to-device interactions.
  • Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • Ownership of meaningful mobile development work.
  • The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents.
  • Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your role in developing Android applications and Kotlin Multiplatform solutions.
  • Any practical experience with GPS, BLE, UWB, or similar technologies.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with an example of how they helped you deliver a working application or feature.

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer - Tools & Activation
jobs.excerpt: Hello.  We're Prismic. We believe the future is all about autonomous websites and hyper-personalised user journeys.
jobs.description:
Hello. We're Prismic.

We believe the future is all about autonomous websites and hyper-personalised user journeys.

We're building the Autonomous Website Experience. Today you choose tools, model content, write code, and fix bugs by hand. Tomorrow you say what you want, and the system builds, fixes, and improves the site with you, from the first demo to the daily updates.

The Tools and Activation Team

Our mission: build the tools that let developers, marketers, and AI agents, use Prismic efficiently, and design the most frictionless onboarding for different personalities and personas.

We own two sides of that problem.

  • The tools. The CLI and MCP are how agents work with Prismic. An agent in Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, or Codex should be able to do everything you can do in the UI, without guessing, getting stuck, or inventing glue code. The developer tooling is what closes the loop - how developers deliver slices and manage their day to day work. We make those surfaces reliable, complete, and efficient.

  • The first mile. People don't just arrive from different places. They also arrive with different experience and different knowledge of Prismic. Everyone should be able to onboard. We design those paths for that range of people, and we are responsible for making them the best.

What we measure

We measure two things.

Activation with our tools. How many developers and agents activate with the MCP, whether they stay, and how often they come back.

Onboarding to production. How many people start with Prismic and deploy their website to production.

The problems you'd pick up

Here's what's actually on the table right now.

CLI and MCP that make humans and agents first-class users of Prismic. The CLI is how agents set up projects, model content, and stay in the codebase. The MCP is how they read, edit, and operate on content. Together they should cover the full surface of the product, not a thin slice of it. The hard part is not exposing an API. It is making people and agents efficient: the right tools, the right defaults, the right errors, and a path that doesn't fall apart past the happy path.

Developer tooling that stays out of the way. This is how developers actually interact with Prismic day to day: scaffolding projects, modeling data, developing Slices and syncing with remote server. You would help shape that interactions so people can do their work without fighting the tool.

Onboarding that works for different people. People arrive from different sources and they arrive with very different experience. All of them should be able to onboard. You would help design those paths and keep them coherent.

Why this role is interesting

  • You build the technology, and you build it fast. We prototype quickly, learn from it, and keep what works. An idea goes from POC to something customers use without a long chain of handoffs.

  • You talk to customers directly. Product Engineers here don't wait for a spec. You talk to users, decide what to build, ship it, and see whether it moved the numbers.

  • Your users are humans and agents. Designing for developers, marketers, and AI agents at once is a new problem. There is no established playbook, so you help write it.

  • Your impact is easy to see. Activation and websites in production are numbers you can watch move because of what you shipped.

Role 💫

We're looking for a Senior Product Engineer to join the Tools and Activation Team.

We chose the title Product Engineer on purpose. We're not looking for someone who ships clean code against a spec. We want someone who owns the outcome: talks to users, decides what to build with product, ships it, and is accountable for whether it moved the numbers. It's less about handoffs and more about owning the work end to end.

This is an individual contributor role. You'll have a lot of autonomy over both product and technical decisions, while working closely with product, design, and the rest of the engineering team.

Are you the one? 🧠

This role leans backend. You will spend most of your time on services, APIs and CLIs. Frontend is part of the job when the path to activation lives in a UI, but it is not the centre of gravity.

Ideally, you:

  • Are a strong backend engineer in TypeScript, comfortable designing APIs and CLIs

  • Have built developer-facing surfaces like CLIs or SDKs. You’re used to commands that compose, contracts that stay stable, output that tells you what to do next, and errors specific enough to recover from.

  • Have built agent-facing surfaces before. The client of our products is not always a human. Agents get stuck on interactive prompts, vague errors, and incomplete tools. You understand the problems and know how to solve them.

  • Are at home with ambiguous problems and short feedback loops. You can take an idea to a POC quickly, learn from it, and decide what to keep.

You also bring the baseline every Product Engineer here shares:

  • You're full-stack enough to work across the stack when the problem requires it, including databases and infrastructure.

  • You handle complex integrations and product problems without waiting to be told what to do.

  • You have hands-on experience with agentic AI systems, or strong curiosity about them.

  • You care about quality engineering: testing, observability, traceability.

We weigh competencies over years of experience or job titles.

Bonus points

  • You've shipped or maintained an MCP server, or a CLI designed for both humans and agents.

  • You've worked on developer experience in a product company.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We care about how you think, how you build, and how you raise the level of the system around you.

Technologies and tools we use daily

  • TypeScript (NodeJS)

  • React

  • AWS

  • SST

  • Serverless architecture

  • PostgreSQL

  • LangChain / LangGraph

  • Playwright / Vitest

  • GitHub Actions

  • Cursor / Claude Code / Codex

How we hire

Our process tests what the job actually involves.

  1. Intro call with our talent partner.

  2. Technical exercise - you'll work in TypeScript, and we look at async behaviour and code quality alongside the AI-specific parts.

  3. System design. Deliberately not AI-specific. We want to see how you think about APIs, servers, databases, and architecture in general.

  4. Meet the team, including your future manager.

You're welcome to use AI tools throughout. That's how we work, so it's how we interview.

What are the perks? 🎉

  • MacBook: get top-notch tech to work with.

  • Home office budget: set up your ideal workspace.

  • Yoga classes: online and onsite, 3x a week.

  • Yearly company gatherings to connect with international teams.

Other benefits may depend on the country you're based in.

Work across borders. Come together in Paris 🌍

We’re an international team, with Paris as our hub for collaboration and connection. Every quarter, everyone at Prismic meets in Paris for our In-Office Week. To build together, share ideas and have fun as a team. Attendance is expected, with dates shared well in advance so everyone can plan.

You’ll work from your country of employment, with arrangements depending on your role and location:

  • Based in Paris: join us in the office once a week.

  • Elsewhere in France: join us in Paris once a month.

  • Outside France: work primarily remotely, alongside our quarterly Paris get-togethers.

Ready to help build the future of the web?

Apply now to become a Senior Product Engineer at Prismic and help us make publishing a team effort.

We're primarily hiring at the Senior level, but we're also open to mid-level engineers with strong ownership who are already comfortable taking on ambiguous problems and driving work end to end.

We can't wait to see what you'll bring to the Collaboration Squad.

Highlights

Senior Product Engineer, Collaboration: Remote (Europe), own Page Builder editing experience, including real-time collaboration & interactive live preview. Full-stack, high autonomy, AI-native team.

jobs.excerpt: About ZyteZyte is a leader in web data extraction.
jobs.description:
About Zyte

Zyte is a leader in web data extraction. Our full-stack Zyte API and world-class data services help thousands of companies, from individual developers to global enterprises, turn the web into reliable, structured data. We're a remote-first, globally distributed team that ships fast and lets results speak.

This is a transformative moment for web data, and AI is reshaping both sides of the market. The world needs web data more than ever: to train models, power agents and feed AI applications, so the audience for web data is exploding - creating new personas and new buying journeys almost overnight. At the same time AI is changing how that data is collected - from manual work by engineers to automation with AI.

Zyte is unique in solving both challenges of web data - the software needed for reliable access to websites and the AI and skills needed to turn web content into structured data. We have an important mission in the AI revolution.

The role

We're hiring a Senior Growth Product Manager to lead our self-serve acquisition and growth journeys across the channels used by personas hungry for web data. Our users are engineers, data teams and the builders of AI agents, and your job is to understand what they seek, what they try first and what convinces them to stay.

You'll lead conversion and growth across channels: our website, agents an the developer ecosystem. You'll be product owner for the website and application UI and will take a data driven approach to customer acquisition and growth, from traffic through trial, activation and subscription, right up to an account-managed relationship.

Our goal is to engage 500,000 developers next year who need web data and this role is central to converting them. In this role you'll shape the rhythm of funnels and experiments, ideating and iterating with a talented team on how we can improve experiences, find truths in data and build on the insight of customers to figure out the next growth step. You'll be fascinated by how engineers evaluate tools, how AI is changing the way they build and what it takes to earn their trust. You'll work to explode an audience in a market that is itself exploding, and to be able to point at the growth curve and say "I did that".

What you'll do

Manage the self-serve funnel end-to-end. Define, measure and improve every stage: signup, trial, activation, conversion to paid and expansion.

Be product owner for the website and product UI. Set the roadmap and priorities for our web presence and platform UX, working directly with the development lead, engineers and designers to ship improvements that capture demand and drive funnel activity.

Optimise the funnel as a conversion mechanism - design and run experiments, work closely with our design and product marketing teams on formats, copy and narratives for conversion.

Optimise PLG journeys that start in the developer ecosystem. Optimise the buying journeys that begin in open source and in the emerging ecosystems of agents, turning developer adoption and ecosystem presence into activation and growth. This means deeply understanding developer workflows: docs, SDKs, code examples and the first ten minutes of hands-on experience.

Build intelligent customer data and nurture growth. Build customer data based on usage and firmographics, and use this to nurture customers for growth with tailored onboarding, relevant content and (with our RevOps function) identify when our sales professionals should reach out and make contact. .

Run a rigorous experimentation practice. Develop hypotheses, ship A/B tests and funnel experiments, and report results honestly, doubling down on what works and killing what doesn't.

Requirements

  • Proven results driving growth and managing funnels in a B2B SaaS or developer-focused business with a self-serve or PLG motion.
  • A deep curiosity about how engineers work and adopt tools. You've marketed or built for technical audiences and know that developers don't respond to marketing; they respond to products that respect their time.
  • Experience with developer tools, APIs, data products or technical audiences.
  • You prototype your own ideas: you use AI coding tools to vibe-code experiments, mockups and working demos rather than waiting for engineering capacity.
  • A track record of making websites effective engines for capturing demand and driving funnel activity; you've owned conversion, not just traffic.
  • Demonstrated success in customer growth and nurture: activation, free-to-paid conversion, expansion and churn reduction.
  • Intelligent, practical use of data: comfortable defining metrics, instrumenting funnels, segmenting customers and combining product signals with messaging and human outreach.
  • Experience working as a product owner or growth PM with engineering and design teams: writing clear requirements, prioritising ruthlessly and shipping iteratively.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills; you can align marketing, product, CS, RevOps and sales around a shared funnel.
  • 5–8+ years in growth, growth product management or lifecycle/funnel roles.

Nice to have

  • You've written production code or contributed to open source.
  • Familiarity with experimentation platforms, product analytics (e.g. Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4), marketing automation and CRM tooling.
  • Experience building product-led sales (PQL) motions or platform-to-enterprise upgrade paths.

How we'll measure sucess

Signup-to-activation rate, trial-to-paid conversion, self-serve revenue and expansion revenue, funnel velocity and the quality of PQLs handed to sales.

Benefits

By joining the Zyte team, you will:

  • Become part of a self-motivated, progressive, multi-cultural team
  • Have the freedom and flexibility to work from where you do your best work
  • Attend conferences and meet with team members from across the globe
  • Work with cutting-edge open source technologies and tools

jobs.excerpt: Location: 100% Remote Employment: Full-time, long-term position Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility About UsWe are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies.
jobs.description:
Location: 100% Remote
Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve our engineering workflows, and build practical knowledge across the team.

We are looking for a senior developer who can take ownership of iOS development, deliver reliable software, and help our team become more effective at building applications with AI.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior iOS App Developer with an excellent background in native iOS development using Swift and SwiftUI, together with practical experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into iOS applications.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will develop and improve our iOS application, integrate shared application logic, solve complex technical problems, and establish effective workflows for AI-assisted and agentic development.

Experience with GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or related location and proximity technologies would be particularly valuable.

You will also share your knowledge with our internal team, including mentoring a junior team member who is learning to build mobile applications through AI-assisted development, often referred to as “vibe coding.”

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and improve our native iOS application using Swift and SwiftUI.
  • Integrate Kotlin Multiplatform modules into the iOS application and collaborate on shared business logic.
  • Implement platform-specific functionality while maintaining consistent behavior across iOS and Android.
  • Implement and troubleshoot location and proximity features involving GPS, BLE, UWB, and related device capabilities.
  • Address practical iOS challenges such as permissions, application lifecycle, background execution, battery consumption, and device compatibility.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents extensively to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and support testing.
  • Set up and improve agentic development workflows, including task decomposition, project context, automated checks, and review processes.
  • Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
  • Test relevant functionality on real devices and investigate issues that automated tests alone may not reveal.
  • Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and clear explanations.
  • Support application signing, release preparation, and distribution through TestFlight and the App Store.
  • Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production iOS applications.
  • Excellent practical knowledge of Swift, SwiftUI, and the iOS development ecosystem.
  • Practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform and its integration into native iOS applications.
  • Solid understanding of application architecture, asynchronous programming, lifecycle management, and state management.
  • Strong debugging skills across application code, shared modules, APIs, and device behavior.
  • Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
  • A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
  • The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain technical decisions.
  • Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly.
  • The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • GPS positioning, location accuracy, geofencing, and sensor data.
  • BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and proximity detection.
  • UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility.
  • NFC and other device-to-device interactions.
  • Interoperability between Swift and Kotlin Multiplatform, including asynchronous operations and error handling.
  • Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • Ownership of meaningful iOS development work.
  • The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents.
  • Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your role in developing and releasing iOS applications.
  • Your experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into native iOS projects.
  • Any practical experience with GPS, BLE, UWB, or similar technologies.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with an example of how they helped you deliver a working application or feature.
  • Your experience mentoring junior developers or colleagues learning AI-assisted development.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio links, App Store references, or GitHub links are welcome where available.

Hotel :

What’s in it for you?

The Atrium SPIRIT is a belief in the power ofService, Perseverance, Inclusion, Respect, Innovation, and Teamwork to create an environment where everyone thrives. We go above and beyond to deliver exceptional guest experiences, work together to overcome challenges, and are passionate about positively impacting those around us.

  • Career Growth & Learning – 40% of our management hires are internal promotions!
  • Invest in Your Future– 401(k) plan with company match.

  • Paid Time Off & Vacation – Enjoy exclusive Atrium Traveler and brand discount programs to explore new destinations
  • Perks That Fit Your Life – Enjoy DailyPay, wellness programs, tuition reimbursement, and exclusive discounts on your favorite brands and services.
  • Purpose & Impact – Make a difference through Atrium’s community service and volunteer programs.

Job Description

We have a pipeline of AI and automation opportunities. Now we’re looking for someone who can help bring them to life.


This is a remote internship within approved U.S. locations. Candidates must be physically located in the United States while performing internship duties and must have valid authorization to work in the United States before beginning employment.


Work performed outside the United States is not supported for this position.


Your work will focus on improving business processes through solutions built within Atrium’s approved Microsoft and Claude environments. You’ll start with a prioritized project, understand the business need, build and test a solution, and document your work so others can use and maintain it.

This is a hands-on building role—not an assignment to spend a semester writing about what AI might do someday.

What you’ll do

  • Review existing process documentation and workflow recommendations, including those captured through Scribe.
  • Work with your supervisor to select and scope an initial automation or AI-enabled project.
  • Translate business needs into practical workflows, applications, or tools.
  • Build solutions using approved technologies such as Microsoft Power Automate, Microsoft Copilot, and Claude Code.
  • Explore connections between systems using APIs or other approved integration methods.
  • Test functionality, troubleshoot issues, and refine solutions based on stakeholder feedback.
  • Document your approach, configuration, testing, limitations, and maintenance needs.
  • Demonstrate progress and contribute to a final project presentation and handoff.

What you’ll bring

We’re looking for a current student with demonstrated technical ability and an interest in applying AI and automation to real business problems.


You should be able to show:

  • Hands-on building experience. You’ve completed an automation, application, integration, or AI-enabled project and can explain your contribution.
  • AI fluency. You use AI tools thoughtfully to build, troubleshoot, and improve solutions—not just generate answers.
  • Process thinking. You can break a workflow into steps and identify opportunities to simplify or automate it.
  • Technical problem-solving. You’re comfortable experimenting, diagnosing issues, and testing whether a solution works.
  • Clear communication. You can explain technical work to people who may not share your technical background.
  • Ownership and follow-through. You can manage a defined assignment, communicate blockers, and leave useful documentation behind.
  • Sound judgment. You’re willing to follow company requirements for data handling, system access, and approved tools.

You do not need prior corporate employment experience. Coursework, personal projects, hackathons, research, and student-organization projects can all demonstrate your abilities.


Helpful technical experience

Experience with some of the following would be valuable; you do not need to check every box:

  • Claude Code or comparable AI-assisted development tools.
  • Microsoft Power Automate and Microsoft Copilot.
  • Workflow automation platforms such as n8n or Make.
  • APIs and connecting applications or services.
  • Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  • Data tools such as SQL or Snowflake.

Strong experience with n8n, Make, or another automation platform can be relevant even if you have not yet worked extensively in Power Automate.

Hospitality experience is welcome but not required. We’re interested in how you think, what you can build, and the perspective you bring.


What success looks like

At the beginning of the internship, you and your supervisor will agree on a project scope, milestones, and expected deliverables.

Depending on the project’s complexity, your final work may include:

  • A clearly defined business problem and proposed solution.
  • A documented proof of concept.
  • A working prototype or pilot.
  • Testing results and an explanation of limitations.
  • A demonstration for relevant stakeholders.
  • Documentation and a handoff that allows the team to continue the work.

The goal is useful, well-tested progress—not a long list of unfinished experiments.


What you’ll gain

  • Experience applying AI and automation to real business workflows.
  • Collaboration with technology and business stakeholders.
  • Practice moving from a business problem to a tested solution.
  • Feedback on your technical work, communication, and documentation.
  • A structured internship with clear expectations and review points.

Academic-credit requirements can be discussed during the selection process.


What to share when applying

Please submit:

  • Your résumé.
  • A brief description of one or two projects you’ve completed.
  • A link, screenshot, short demonstration, or other examples of your work, if available.
  • Your availability including potential start date and typical weekly hours.

For each project, tell us:

  • What problem were you trying to solve?
  • What tools did you use?
  • What did you personally build?
  • How did you test it?
  • What worked, and what would you improve?

A full portfolio is not required. One well-explained project is more valuable than a long list of tools.


Please share only material you are authorized to disclose. Do not include confidential information, credentials, or proprietary code from another organization.


Selection process

Selected candidates will participate in a panel conversation led by the internship supervisor and relevant team members. Be prepared to walk through a completed project, explain your decisions, and discuss how you approach unfamiliar problems.

Atrium is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected Veteran status.

Working closely with solution architects, functional consultants, and business stakeholders, the developer ensures seamless integration between data platforms and analytical applications while maintaining high standards of usability, performance, and data accuracy.

  • Develop and enhance planning applications, including input forms, interactive tables, filters, navigation components, and reporting dashboards.
  • Design, develop, and maintain data models, graphical views, SQL views, and analytical datasets within SAP Datasphere.
  • Implement and optimize data integration processes, data flows, and transformations across SAP and non-SAP systems.
  • Develop semantic models, dimensions, measures, and business logic to support analytics, reporting, and planning requirements.
  • Ensure seamless connectivity and data integration between SAP Datasphere and SAP Analytics Cloud.
  • Collaborate with solution architects, functional consultants, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions.
  • Optimize application performance, data processing efficiency, and overall user experience across SAC and Datasphere environments.
  • Support troubleshooting, testing, technical documentation, deployment activities, and ongoing solution enhancements.
  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), particularly front-end development, application design, and data visualization.
  • Proven experience developing SAC Stories, interactive dashboards, planning applications, and user-friendly interfaces.
  • Experience with SAP Datasphere, including data modeling, development, and integration.
  • Strong knowledge of SAP Datasphere Data Builder, graphical views, SQL views, analytical models, and semantic modeling concepts.
  • Experience with SAC application scripting, JavaScript, and interactive application development.
  • Solid understanding of SQL, SAP HANA, data transformations, and enterprise data modeling principles.
  • Experience integrating SAP Analytics Cloud with SAP Datasphere and other SAP data sources.
  • Understanding of UI/UX design principles, usability standards, and performance optimization.
  • Familiarity with SAC Planning functionalities, including planning models, data actions, version management, and input controls.

Complete Description:

We are undertaking a modernization initiative to replace an aging eligibility platform with a new statewide eligibility system (EDEN). As part of this effort, the legacy Child Support Enforcement system (ICAR) must continue to exchange critical data with the new platform through a series of file-based interfaces and batch processes.

The Mainframe Developer will play a key role in supporting the integration and transition between the legacy child support system and the new eligibility platform. This position will focus on analysis, development, testing, deployment, and support of mainframe applications and interfaces that enable seamless data exchange during the modernization effort.

Position Summary:

The Mainframe Developer will design, develop, modify, test, and support mainframe programs and batch processes that facilitate integration between the legacy Child Support Enforcement system (ICAR) and the new Eligibility Determination system (EDEN). The resource will work closely with business analysts, architects, testers, and technical teams to implement interface updates, maintain data integrity, and support the transition from legacy data sources to modernized eligibility services.

Key Responsibilities:

Mainframe Application Development

  • Develop, enhance, and maintain COBOL and JCL programs that process interface files between ICAR and EDEN.
  • Modify file layouts, data mappings, transformation logic, and validation routines based on business and technical requirements.
  • Enhance batch processing workflows, GDG structures, and VSAM datasets to support evolving integration requirements.
  • Support modernization efforts by replacing legacy eligibility data sources with EDEN-derived data.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot existing production processes and interfaces.

Preferred Qualifications:

jobs.excerpt: Hello.  We’re Teya. Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.
jobs.description:
Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that.

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you

Your Mission

Small businesses are the backbone of our communities — yet they remain underserved by traditional banks and legacy payment providers. As a Principal Backend Engineer, you will play a defining role in changing that.

Your mission is to design and build the resilient, scalable fintech infrastructure that underpins our most critical business initiatives. This isn’t about owning a single service — it’s about owning outcomes. You will drive the technical success of the platforms that power payments, merchant onboarding, transaction processing, and operational workflows across Europe.

You’ll operate at the intersection of engineering and business strategy, shaping systems that must be secure, compliant, highly available, and capable of scaling with rapid growth. The decisions you make will directly influence how quickly we can launch new products, enter new markets, and serve thousands of merchants.

This role goes beyond technical leadership. You will define and evolve the architectural foundations that multiple teams depend on, bringing clarity to ambiguity and ensuring our most important initiatives succeed.

What You’ll Do

  • Own and drive the architecture behind our most critical platforms, ensuring they scale with the business and unlock new capabilities

  • Design and evolve high-scale, cloud-native systems powering payments and merchant experiences

  • Lead the development of resilient, secure, and compliant services for high-volume transaction processing

  • Shape and drive adoption of modern backend practices (Java 17/21, Spring Boot 3, Kotlin, clean architecture)

  • Architect event-driven systems (Kafka) that enable scalable, decoupled domains across teams

  • Define and enforce standards for API-first development (REST/gRPC) and domain-driven design (DDD)

  • Set the bar for availability, performance, fault tolerance, and observability across critical systems

  • Partner deeply with Product, Data, and leadership to translate business priorities into scalable technical strategy

  • Lead cross-organisational initiatives that are essential to company growth and market expansion

  • Influence engineering direction through hands-on contribution, design leadership, and mentorship

  • Bring structure to ambiguity across technical, regulatory, and operational domains

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of experience building and operating distributed, production-grade backend systems

  • Proven track record operating at Senior Staff or Principal level, driving architecture across multiple teams or domains

  • Deep expertise in Java (17+), Spring Boot, and modern backend engineering practices

  • Strong experience with microservices, event-driven architecture, and asynchronous systems

  • Experience building systems for high throughput, low latency, and reliability, ideally in fintech or transaction-heavy environments

  • Strong grounding in system design, data structures, and performance trade-offs

  • Hands-on experience with AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes in production environments

  • Proven ability to implement observability, resilience patterns, and CI/CD best practices

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence and align stakeholders

  • A track record of mentoring senior engineers and leading through ambiguity

The Perks

  • Health Insurance;

  • Meal Allowance;

  • 25 days of Annual leave (+ Bank holidays);

  • Public Transportation Card;

  • Frequent team events & activities in the office and outside;

  • Office snacks every day;

  • Friendly, comfortable and informal office environment.

We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, stronger outcomes, and a more supportive workplace for all.

About Smart Working

At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. About the Role

As a Senior Python Engineer (Backend / Data), you will join an existing engineering team to strengthen backend development and data engineering capabilities. This is a long-term, ongoing opportunity, focused on building and maintaining reliable production systems.

You will work closely with the engineering team and an existing DevOps/SRE engineer on infrastructure, deployments and releases. The role requires independent ownership of assigned work, collaboration across engineering functions and an understanding of how data pipelines support the wider product.

You will contribute to engineering decisions, maintain high standards of data quality, correctness and testing, and propose solutions rather than simply execute assigned tasks. Reliability and thoroughness in production are key priorities.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build and maintain reliable data pipelines in Python on AWS.
  • Build and maintain backend services and APIs using Django and FastAPI.
  • Model, query and optimise data across PostgreSQL and search/NoSQL databases, including OpenSearch, Elasticsearch and DynamoDB.
  • Deploy and run services on Kubernetes, working alongside the DevOps engineer.
  • Take end-to-end ownership of assigned work, including design, testing, code reviews, releases and production support.
  • Work independently on assigned tasks while collaborating closely with the engineering team and DevOps/SRE engineer on infrastructure and releases.
  • Maintain high standards of data quality, correctness and testing while understanding how data pipelines contribute to the wider product.
  • Follow established engineering practices, including code reviews and CI/CD, while adapting to changing priorities.
  • Proactively identify problems, propose solutions and challenge technical decisions when necessary rather than simply executing tickets.
  • Prioritise thoroughness, reliability and production stability when developing and maintaining data pipelines and data stores.

Requirements

  • 6+ years of experience in software engineering, including 5+ years of commercial Python development.
  • 5+ years of Python backend development experience, with strong hands-on engineering capabilities.
  • 3+ years of experience in data pipelines and data engineering, including ETL/ELT processes and batch processing. Relevant technologies include Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, AWS Glue and Step Functions.
  • 3+ years of AWS experience, with practical experience developing and maintaining cloud-based backend services and data pipelines. Strong GCP or Azure experience may be considered on a case-by-case basis.
  • 3+ years of experience with Python web frameworks, particularly Django or FastAPI. Flask is an acceptable alternative.
  • 3+ years of PostgreSQL experience, including data modelling, querying and optimisation. MySQL or SQL Server experience may be considered where strong SQL expertise is demonstrated elsewhere.
  • 2+ years of experience with non-relational or search databases, such as Elasticsearch, OpenSearch or DynamoDB. Relevant alternatives include MongoDB, Redis and Cassandra.
  • 2+ years of Kubernetes experience, including deploying and running services. Docker combined with ECS or EKS exposure may be considered as an alternative.
  • Ability to independently own technical tasks from design through implementation, testing, release and production support.
  • Strong attention to data quality, correctness, testing and production reliability.
  • Ability to collaborate with engineering and infrastructure teams while independently proposing solutions and challenging decisions where appropriate.
  • Ability to follow engineering practices and adapt to changing priorities.

Nice to Have

  • 1+ year of experience with workflow orchestration, using Airflow or similar technologies. Alternatives include Celery and cron-based schedulers.
  • 1+ year of experience with streaming or event-processing technologies, such as Kafka, Kinesis or SQS. RabbitMQ is an acceptable alternative.
  • 1+ year of experience with Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD, including Terraform and GitHub Actions. Alternatives include Pulumi and GitLab CI.
  • Previous experience leading a technical project or taking complete end-to-end ownership of a data pipeline or backend service

jobs.excerpt: About DistruDistru is the #1 ERP in the cannabis industry with $15B in sales processed through our platform.
jobs.description:
About Distru

Distru is the #1 ERP in the cannabis industry with $15B in sales processed through our platform. We've built a battle-tested ERP and B2B eCommerce platform that powers inventory, manufacturing, sales, and logistics, and we're now building AI infrastructure on top of it to give commercial businesses their all-in-one AI stack.

We're growing and profitable, with 5/5 stars on Glassdoor. Our investors include Felicis Ventures, Global Founders Capital, Poseidon Asset Management, and Village Global, who have funded companies such as Shopify, Cruise, HelloFresh, Facebook, Slack, and Opendoor.

Get to know the team, our culture and our full benefits at !

The Role

AI is at an inflection point for enterprise use, and AI assistants like Claude, Codex, and Grok are seeing record adoption at work. We believe the system of record has never been more valuable for organizing the data AI acts on.

We started with our AI Order Agent, now rolled out across our customer base, which lets buyers submit orders from any source in any format. It's the first piece of a much bigger agentic ecosystem we’re building, and we're moving most of our engineering effort to AI-first work to build it.

You'll own the architecture and technical direction of our AI product suite, partnering with our Director of AI Engineering, including:

  • Agentic harness: a multi-agent system that safely operates across a business's core tools (ERP, CRM, spreadsheets, calendars, email, analytics, compliance systems)
  • MCP: our MCP that connects Distru to external AI harnesses
  • Context Layer: our context layer that ingests customer data, builds memories and profiles, and feeds back into our harness to create more personalized AI experiences for our customers
  • Evals: the eval suites that make our agents reliable in production
  • And more…

You’ll be working directly on the AI system from the ground up and make strong, opinionated calls on the agentic stack and where it goes next. The AI space moves fast and the specifics will change, so this technical vision is something you'll mold.

You'll report to the VP of Engineering and the Director of AI Engineering, and work closely with the rest of the product team, eng team, and our customers.

What you'll do

    Agentic engineering

  • Architect and build a production multi-agent system that can safely take actions across Distru and our customer’s core systems
  • Iterate and maintain the MCP that connects Distru to Claude & Codex.
  • Own reliability, observability, and durable execution end to end. The harness takes real actions on customers' data, so the bar is high.
  • Write evals to improve our agentic systems from real customer use cases
  • Build a unified data system that pulls data from multiple sources into a singular data layer that can be exposed to Claude & Codex via an MCP
  • Build a contextual memory system that ingests our customers' data and improves how our agents work for them
  • Set the architectural standards for how agents are built, tested, and shipped at Distru, and bring the rest of eng along

    • AI research & experimentation

  • Keep pace with the latest agentic frameworks, harnesses, toolkits, models, and bring in better approaches as they emerge
  • Rapidly prototype new ideas to present to our team and our customers

    • Engineering workflow

  • Build hands-on with Claude Code and similar tools as part of your own workflow
  • Improve our agentic coding workflow and bring new discoveries to the team

What success looks like at 6 months

  • You've shipped core improvements to our harness in production that our customers use daily, with clear observability and iteration for improvement
  • You’ve shipped and iterated on many MCP tools and improvements
  • Every agent you own has an eval suite and observability, so the team catches regressions before customers do
  • You own the architecture of the agentic stack, and other engineers build against patterns you set
  • You’ve built prototypes on how our agentic infrastructure can improve (i.e. a new way to retrieve memories, an agentic onboarding process for our customers)
  • You’ve raised the technical bar on at least one thing the team was doing the slow way

What we look for

    AI fluency

    For every AI role, we look for three things:

  • Tool fluency: you build with Claude Code or similar every day, you've built your own skills, agents, or workflows, and you can explain why your setup looks the way it does.
  • Workflow fluency: you write evals before you trust a prompt, and you know when a model is the wrong tool and plain code is the right one.
  • Build fluency: you've put agents in front of real users, with guardrails, observability, and a way to roll back.

    • You use AI tools daily and can tell us specifically where your fluency is strong and where you're still building it.

    Must have

  • 7+ years in full-stack development, ideally on B2B SaaS applications
  • Multi-agent harnesses: hands-on experience building multi-agent harnesses in production, not just prototypes or personal projects
  • MCPs: you've built MCPs that are used in production
  • Production systems: a strong grasp of reliability, observability, permissions, and safe workflow execution
  • Product and engineering: you've operated as both, and you're comfortable owning scoping and decisions, not just implementation
  • Modern stack: proficiency in React, TypeScript, Node, PostgreSQL, GraphQL, and LangGraph, and you pick up new tools and frameworks quickly
  • Startup agility: you've worked at an early-stage startup (under 20 engineers) and you’ve been the one setting direction in that ambiguity, not waiting for it
  • Low ego: you're team-first and measure success by what shipped and whether it worked, not by internal politics
  • Influence: you’ve shaped roadmap, not just executed it
  • Clear communication: you raise concerns and propose solutions before being asked

    • Strong signal

  • Background building supply chain, ERP, CRM, B2B marketplace, or accounting software
  • UX design experience
  • Agentic systems work beyond the must-haves, such as evaluation frameworks or agent-to-agent protocols
  • Experience using Claude Code (or similar) to build products on your own
  • Cannabis industry experience

How we work

  • We love building with AI. Trying new models the week they drop, building agents for fun, and forming strong opinions on what works. We invest in it with company-wide AI growth with classes and workshops, AI demo days, AI hackathons, and access to best-in-class models and tools.
  • Taste in building. A lot of this role comes down to knowing what to build, what to cut, and what a great agentic experience feels like for the user.
  • We stay close to the customer. You'll talk to customers and our GTM team directly, not through a chain of tickets.
  • You'll build on what we've learned. You'll have access to the team's combined AI knowledge and the processes and skills we've built.

    • For the full picture of our culture and who thrives here, see .

Benefits

Our careers page is the best way to get to know us: the full benefits, our yearly offsites, who thrives here, and what the team says about working at Distru.

Here are a few highlights (exact benefits vary by country and employment type):

  • Fully remote across 4 continents
  • Employee-friendly option terms: after 2 years, a 10-year window to exercise if you leave
  • 18 days PTO + 11 holidays (sick days don't count toward PTO)
  • Medical, dental, vision + 401(k) for US employees
  • The best AI tools available and a generous AI stipend for everything else
  • Yearly in-person team offsites

Interview process

  • Application questions: three short written questions in Lever on how you build with LLMs
  • Recruiter screen (30 min): your background, the most complex AI product you've worked on, and your personal AI tool stack
  • Technical interview (45–60 min): a deep dive into a complex product you've built, a live harness design discussion, and a screen-share walkthrough of your day-to-day setup
  • Harness take-home (3–4 hours): spec a real feature on our agentic harness across product and UX, system design, and implementation details
  • Take-home review (60 min): a technical deep dive into your submission with two engineers, including how your design holds up when a constraint changes
  • References and offer

Distru was formed by an environment of mutual respect and trust made up by people working together without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information (including characteristics and testing), military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by law. We believe that diversity and inclusion among our team members is critical to our success and we proactively strive to recruit, develop and retain the best and brightest people from the most diverse candidate pools we can find all over the world.

jobs.excerpt: About Unleash Unleashis a feature management platform helping development teams experiment faster with new features, with less risk and more efficiency.
jobs.description:
About Unleash

Unleashis a feature management platform helping development teams experiment faster with new features, with less risk and more efficiency. Our mantra is "create with freedom, release with confidence".

Feature management has emerged as a core component of Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) and Experimentation Platforms, allowing developers to test new features incrementally, roll back with precision, and run experiments that drive real product decisions. Unleash is the largest open source solution for feature management onGitHub, and serves some of the world's most security-conscious enterprises. From financial institutions and fintechs to large retailers and government bodies.

Unleash hassolid funding from investorsacross the US, UK, and Norway, and is growing.
We're a remote-first company across 10 countries, with a Nordic culture based on trust, transparency, and autonomy.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Developer Advocate to join our small but growing DevRel team. You'll work closely with the Head of DevRel and own a significant portion of our technical content strategy and community execution, from blog posts and tutorials to live demos, workshops, and conference talks.

This is a high-autonomy role. You won't be handed a backlog to execute. You'll help shape what gets built and why, co-owning parts of the DevRel strategy. We're a small team and we move fast, so the ability to self-direct, prioritize ruthlessly, and deliver with speed and precision matters a lot.
Our primary audience is the technical practitioner: developers, DevOps engineers, platform engineers, and software architects working in and around enterprise software. You'll need to be able to speak their language with credibility. That means being hands-on, technically sharp, and genuinely curious about the problems they face.

Responsibilities

  • Own and execute technical content across formats: written tutorials, blog posts, code examples, video walkthroughs, and live demos

  • Speak at developer conferences, meetups, and community events

  • Design and run developer workshops (in-person and virtual)

  • Contribute to the Unleash OSS ecosystem: code samples, integrations, documentation improvements, and SDK examples

  • Engage with the developer community across channels and represent Unleash with authenticity

  • Collaborate with Customer Success and Go-to-Market teams to identify technical content gaps and opportunities

  • Stay sharp on the AI/LLM tooling landscape and help translate Unleash's value into that context for developers building AI-powered applications

About you

  • You have 5+ years of hands-on experience, spanning real software engineering and Developer Relations (you've done both, not just talked about both)

  • You've shipped production code and can build working demos, integrations, and code samples from scratch

  • You have genuine experience in Developer Relations: you've spoken at conferences, produced technical content, and know what it takes to build credibility in a developer community

  • You're comfortable with CI/CD, cloud-native technologies, and modern DevOps/platform engineering practices

  • You have hands-on experience building with AI/LLM tools and can speak fluently about integrating AI into real applications

  • You can speak credibly to a technical enterprise audience of developers, architects, and platform teams in large organizations, without losing the startup instinct for speed and pragmatism

  • You thrive with autonomy. You don't need a lot of hand-holding, and you default to action over process

  • A growing LinkedIn or YouTube presence is a strong plus. We're not looking for influencer-scale followings, but an established voice in the developer community signals the right mindset

  • Familiarity with OpenFeature or the feature management space is a bonus, not a requirement

Skills & Experience

  • Experience level: Senior Individual Contributor, 10+ years across software engineering and Developer Relations

  • Core skills: Technical content creation, public speaking, live demos, developer education

  • Technical skills:Node.js, TypeScript, CI/CD pipelines, cloud-native technologies (e.g. Kubernetes, OpenFeature), AI/LLM tooling and integrations

  • Additional skills: OSS contribution, SDK/integration development, video production, community building

Logistics

  • Base salary: $230-250K + Equity

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Reports to: Head of DevRel

  • Location: NYC preferred, other major East Coast cities considered

  • Remote working: Fully remote

  • Working timezones: EST, with some overlapping with CET

  • Visa sponsorship: Not available

    Company Benefits

    Competitive salary, Stock options, Benefits Package, Annual company offsite, Flexible schedule, Fully remote.

jobs.title: Senior AI Product Manager, Evals & Annotations
jobs.excerpt: About ArizeAI is rapidly transforming the world.  As generative AI reshapes industries, teams need powerful ways to monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize their AI systems.
jobs.description:
About Arize

AI is rapidly transforming the world. As generative AI reshapes industries, teams need powerful ways to monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize their AI systems. That’s where we come in. Arize AI is the leading AI & Agent Engineering observability and evaluation platform, empowering AI engineers to ship high-performing, reliable agents and applications. From first prototype to production scale, Arize unifies build, test, and run in a single workspace, so teams can ship faster with confidence.

Arize serves a rapidly growing customer base of 150+ leading enterprises and Fortune 500 companies. Customers like , Uber, Siemens, and PepsiCo leverage Arize to deliver AI that works.

The Opportunity

Evaluations are central to how AI developers understand, measure, and improve their applications. As AI systems become increasingly complex and agentic, developers need cohesive workflows to define what good looks like, evaluate behavior, incorporate human feedback, and continuously improve their applications.

We're looking for a highly technical, product-minded PM to own Evals & Annotations at Arize. You'll own the end-to-end evaluation lifecycle—from eval creation and execution to human review, analysis, and iteration. This is an opportunity to bring together powerful capabilities into a cohesive, best-in-class developer experience while helping define the future of evaluations in a world of increasingly autonomous and managed agents, including through our integration with Dynatrace.

This role is ideal for someone with strong product and UX opinions who doesn't just define requirements but actively shapes the experience. You'll independently explore workflows, build prototypes, and collaborate closely with Design and Engineering to turn ideas into polished, technically sound products. You should be as comfortable working through an interaction design as you are discussing technical tradeoffs with engineers.

While Arize has been acquired, we continue to operate with the urgency, resourcefulness, and hands-on mentality of an early-stage startup. Product, Engineering, and Design collaborate closely, and our founders remain actively involved in product thinking and design. You'll have real ownership while working directly with our cofounder/CPO in an environment that values initiative, constructive debate, and a willingness to jump in wherever needed.

What You'll Do

  • Own Arize's Evals & Annotations product area end-to-end, including eval creation and execution, human review, annotation workflows, and the broader evaluation lifecycle.
  • Set the product strategy and roadmap, balancing customer needs, foundational platform investments, UX improvements, and emerging opportunities in AI and agent development.
  • Drive a best-in-class evaluation experience. Develop strong opinions about how workflows should work, independently prototype solutions, and partner with Design to turn those ideas into intuitive, polished experiences.
  • Shape the future of evaluations as AI development evolves toward autonomous and managed agents, including opportunities within the broader Dynatrace ecosystem.
  • Work closely with Engineering on technically complex problems spanning evaluation execution, backend systems, orchestration, and data infrastructure. Contribute to technical discussions, implementation approaches, and tradeoffs.
  • Spend significant time with customers—typically multiple conversations each week—to understand how they evaluate and improve AI systems, uncover underlying problems, and validate product direction.
  • Collaborate directly with our cofounders and cross-functional teams on product direction, design exploration, and prioritization, bringing independent judgment and turning collaborative thinking into execution.
  • Make clear prioritization decisions across competing demands and drive products from problem definition through launch, adoption, and iteration.

What We're Looking For

  • Significant product management experience independently owning technically complex developer-facing products. We're flexible on exact years of experience for candidates with exceptional technical depth, product judgment, and ownership.
  • Strong understanding of LLM evaluations and AI development workflows, including automated evals, human feedback, experimentation, and how developers iterate on AI applications and agents.
  • Experience with developer tools, AI infrastructure, ML platforms, or adjacent technical products, with a solid understanding of backend systems and software architecture.
  • Strong technical depth and hands-on engineering ability. We don't expect you to ship large features as an IC engineer, but we do expect you to:
    • Debug issues independently and navigate code when needed.
    • Put up small fixes or PRs.
    • Build prototypes and technical proofs of concept.
    • Propose technical implementations and reason through tradeoffs.
    • Hold credible technical discussions with engineers.
  • Excellent product and UX instincts.You can independently define and prototype core product experiences, not just write requirements, while partnering effectively with designers and design engineers to refine and ship them.
  • Strong ownership, initiative, and bias toward action. You're comfortable navigating ambiguity, making tradeoffs, and getting hands-on without waiting for a fully defined roadmap or direction.
  • A collaborative, low-ego approach to working with founders, engineers, and designers. You bring strong opinions, engage in constructive debate, and thrive in an environment where responsibilities overlap.
  • Experience working closely with technical customers, with strong communication skills and the ability to move comfortably between strategy and execution.

Bonus Points, But Not Required

  • Direct experience with LLM evaluation platforms, annotation systems, human-in-the-loop workflows, or agent orchestration.
  • Strong backend or platform engineering background, particularly with distributed systems, workflow orchestration, or data infrastructure.
  • Hands-on programming experience and comfort working across backend and frontend technologies.
  • Experience with LLM-as-a-judge, custom evaluators, experiment tracking, datasets, or feedback-driven improvement workflows.
  • Previous engineering experience or substantial hands-on software development experience.
  • Early-stage or high-growth startup experience, particularly in founder-led environments.

The estimated annual salary for this role is between $200,000-$250,000, plus a competitive equity package. Actual compensation is determined based upon a variety of job related factors that may include: transferable work experience, skill sets, and qualifications. Total compensation also includes a comprehensive benefit package, including: medical, dental, vision, 401(k) plan, unlimited paid time off, generous parental leave plan, and others for mental and wellness support.

While we are a remote-first company, we have opened offices in New York City and the San Francisco Bay Area, as an option for those in those cities who wish to work in-person. For all other employees, there is a WFH monthly stipend to pay for co-working spaces.

More About Arize

Arize’s mission is to make the world’s AI work—and work for people.
Our founders came together through a shared frustration: while investments in AI are growing rapidly across every industry, organizations face a critical challenge—understanding whether AI is performing and how to improve it at scale.

Learn more about what we're doing here:

Diversity & Inclusion @ Arize

Our company's mission is to make AI work and make AI work for the people, we hope to make an impact in bias industry-wide and that's a big motivator for people who work here. We actively hope that individuals contribute to a good culture

  • Regularly have chats with industry experts, researchers, and ethicists across the ecosystem to advance the use of responsible AI
  • Culturally conscious events such as LGBTQ trivia during pride month
  • We have an active Lady Arizers subgroup

jobs.excerpt: About AccelByteAccelByte is the game backend platform trusted by studios from indie to AAA, including 2K, Krafton, Skybound, Striking Distance Studios, and Theorycraft Games.
jobs.description:
About AccelByte

AccelByte is the game backend platform trusted by studios from indie to AAA, including 2K, Krafton, Skybound, Striking Distance Studios, and Theorycraft Games. Our team includes veterans who built the online systems behind Fortnite, Xbox Live, PlayStation, and EA. AccelByte Gaming Services (AGS) turns that experience into managed services for accounts, multiplayer, commerce, and live ops, so studios spend their engineering time on the game.

More than 100 studios and 20 million players rely on AccelByte on a platform validated to millions of concurrent users. We're backed by Sony Interactive Entertainment, SoftBank, Krafton, NetEase Games, Galaxy Interactive, and Dreamhaven.

AGS Public Cloud makes that same backend available to any developer, free to start. Developers sign up, add the SDK for their engine, and can ship their first online feature the same day, paying only as their player base grows. Growing AGS Public Cloud developers is a top company priority.

The role

We're hiring a Sr. Growth Manager to own AGS Public Cloud sign-ups and user acquisition end to end. You'll run all marketing and demand generation for a technical product built for game developers, including the content calendar, paid campaigns, and reporting.

This is a hands-on role. You'll start as the team's sole operator, using AI and automation to do the work of a much larger marketing team, and hire one to two people within your first year. There's a clear path to Head of Growth based on hitting year-one sign-up targets and building out the team.

  • Location: Remote
  • Hours: Regular overlap with US Pacific Time, plus occasional calls during Asia business hours
  • Reports to: COO
  • Works closely with: Product and Engineering on content and onboarding, Sales on studios that need a sales conversation

What you'll own

  • The sign-up number. Set AGS Public Cloud sign-up and activation targets with the COO, forecast them, and hit them across both self-serve and sales-assisted paths.
  • Demand generation and paid acquisition. Plan, launch, and measure campaigns across paid search and social, developer communities (including our Discord), and technical SEO. Allocate a lean budget across channels based on CAC.
  • The content calendar. Own it, and coordinate with Product on launches, release notes, tutorials, sample projects, and docs that get developers to a working integration faster.
  • AI-driven marketing operations. Design, build, and run automated workflows for content production, campaign operations, lead enrichment and routing, and reporting.
  • The funnel and the handoff. Work with Product to shorten the path from sign-up to a developer's first working integration. Work with Sales to spot high-intent studios and route them quickly.
  • Measurement. Own attribution, activation, and CAC by channel, and report weekly on what's working.
  • Vendors and future hires. Manage contractors and agencies, and hire your first one to two team members.

What success looks like

First 90 days

  • You've audited the funnel from first visit to activated account, along with current channels and content, and you have a reliable baseline with working attribution.
  • You've agreed on a 12-month growth plan and targets.
  • At least one AI workflow is live and saving hours each week.

First 12 months

  • AGS Public Cloud sign-ups and activated accounts hit the year-one targets set in your first 90 days.
  • CAC is known by channel and trending down, with paid spend concentrated in the channels that work.
  • The content calendar runs on a steady cadence with Product, including technical content that drives activation.
  • Automation covers most recurring marketing operations.
  • Your first one to two hires are in place.

What you bring

  • 6+ years in growth or demand generation, including at least 2 years owning an acquisition number at a developer tools, infrastructure, or API-first SaaS company.
  • Experience marketing a technical product to developers through docs, tutorials, and working examples.
  • Enough technical depth to understand SDKs, APIs, and backend services, and to judge whether content is credible to engineers.
  • Hands-on experience running paid campaigns yourself, with the CAC and conversion results to show for it.
  • AI and automation workflows you've built and run yourself. We'll ask you to walk us through one.
  • Experience with both product-led, self-serve funnels and sales-assisted handoff.
  • Strong analytics skills: attribution, funnel and cohort analysis, product usage data, and SQL or an equivalent tool.
  • Clear writing, and the ability to shape technical content with Product.
  • Comfort working remotely across time zones.

Nice to have

  • Background marketing to game developers or studios, or familiarity with game backend and multiplayer infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with free-tier and usage-based pricing models.
  • A track record of growing developer communities on Discord, GitHub, or Reddit.
  • Time as the first or only marketer at an early-stage company.
  • Experience managing contractors, agencies, or a small team.
